title: Administrative Assistant / Bookeeper
description:
Business valuation and litigation consulting firm based near Los Angeles, California. We prepare business, intellectual property, and real estate valuations for tax, estate planning, and litigation matters. Most of our clients are attorneys, CPAs, and family offices.



We’re looking for a reliable Administrative Assistant / Bookkeeper to support the firm’s founder. This is a permanent, long-term role. We want someone who plans to grow with us for years, not someone looking for a short-term placement.



What you’ll do



Manage
, calendar, and scheduling for the founder (US Pacific Time)

Set up new engagements: engagement letters, client folders, document request lists, and follow-up on outstanding items

Organize and track client documents in OneDrive / SharePoint

Do basic bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online: invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, expense categorization, and monthly reconciliations

Format and proofread reports, exhibits, and schedules in Word and Excel

Handle general admin tasks as they come up (vendor coordination, data entry, research)



What we’re looking for



At least 5 years of administrative and/or bookkeeping experience, ideally supporting a US-based professional services firm (accounting, legal, consulting, or similar)

Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills

Excellent written English and close attention to detail (our reports go to courts and the IRS, so accuracy matters)

Comfort handling confidential client information

A stable internet connection, a backup power source, and a quiet place to work

Ability to overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Pacific business hours



Nice to have



Experience with accounting, valuation, or legal documents

Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Adobe Acrobat, or practice management software



Why work with us



Long-term, stable position with a growing firm

Direct work with the founder, with real responsibility and room to take on more over time

Consistent workload and respectful, clear communication



How to apply



Send a short cover letter explaining your relevant experience and why you want a long-term role. Put “Valuation Admin” in the first line of your application so we know you read the full posting. Applications without it won’t be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR)



NetVisits | Remote, Philippines based | Part time | US Eastern hours



About NetVisits

NetVisits is a US digital marketing agency that has been building websites and running campaigns since 2003. Our clients are businesses that want a stronger online presence and more customers from it. For most of them that means some mix of local SEO, AI search visibility (AIO), Google Ads, Meta Ads and ongoing website management. Healthcare providers, law firms, dental practices and home service companies are common, and any business that needs those services is a fit. We are a small team that uses AI systems to do the work a bigger agency does with headcount, and we are growing on purpose. Our founder, Alec Duncan, ran marketing inside two of our client types for six years before going all in on the agency, so we sell what we have run ourselves.



The job in one paragraph

You fill the top of our pipeline so Alec only takes calls with people who are ready to talk. We already have an AI system that finds businesses whose online presence needs work and drafts the first
 to each one in our voice. We also get inbound leads every week from people who have asked for our services, through one of our lead sources and through our website. Those people are waiting for a call. What is missing is the person who sends the outreach, calls the inbound leads fast, follows up and books the discovery call. That is you.



What you will do

- Review the AI-drafted outreach
s at the start of each shift, fix anything that reads wrong, and send them.

- Call every prospect in the sequence.
 on its own rarely books a meeting.

- Call each inbound lead within minutes of it arriving, then follow with a text and an
. Speed wins these.

- Answer website form leads the same business day.

- Run the follow-up cadence in GoHighLevel and keep every contact and pipeline stage current.

- Book qualified discovery calls on Alec's calendar and write a one-page prep brief before each one.

- Send a short weekly report:
s sent, calls made, conversations, calls booked, calls held.

- Tell us what prospects say and object to, so the pitch gets sharper every month.



Who does well here

- Two or more years of outbound sales, appointment setting or SDR work for a US or other English-speaking company. Experience selling marketing, web or software services to business owners moves you to the front of the line.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone with US business owners every day, and your
s go out under our name.

- At home on the phone. Forty dials a day is a normal day.

- Writes a clean, short
 with no fluff.

- Keeps a CRM current without being chased. GoHighLevel is a plus. HubSpot or Salesforce is fine.

- Curious about AI tools. You will use Claude every day and we will train you on our system.

- Able to work US Eastern hours, 9am to 5pm ET, Monday to Friday. That is 9pm to 5am in Manila.

- A quiet workspace, a good headset, a reliable computer and a stable internet connection.



Targets

Your first month is for learning our clients and the pitch while you send and call the queue that is already built. From month two you carry a monthly number for booked discovery calls, agreed with Alec in your first week. By day 90 the expectation is ten booked qualified calls a month, with at least seven held.



Tools you will use

GoHighLevel (CRM, calling, texting and calendar), Gmail, Slack, Claude and our internal client hub.



Compensation

Hourly pay in US dollars, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month, plus a bonus on every deal that closes from a call you booked. We share the numbers in the first conversation.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the word "SDR" as the first word of your message, and include two things: your resume, and a link to a 60-second voice or video recording where you open a cold call to a business owner the way you would on the job. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

title: Accounting Associate (US Clients)
description:
About MAVI



MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.



Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.



The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.



We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.



The Role



We are seeking an Accounting Associate to help high-growth US companies move their financial data from legacy accounting platforms into a modern ERP.



You will handle hands-on accounting work, from cleaning and mapping data to reconciling balances, working alongside senior team members and US-based finance teams. This role is for someone who takes pride in accurate, well-documented work and wants to build specialized expertise in ERP migrations. No prior migration experience is required.



What You’ll Own



• Data preparation. Pull, clean, and organize historical financial data from platforms such as QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, and Xero.

• Mapping. Map accounts, vendors, customers, and departments to the new chart of accounts.

• Data uploads. Prepare journal entries, trial balances, bills, and invoices for upload into the new system.

• Reconciliations. Reconcile balances between the old and new systems across cash, AR, AP, and other key accounts. Resolve discrepancies instead of passing them along.

• Documentation. Keep clear records of your work and help maintain SOPs and checklists.



What We’re Looking For



• 4+ years of accounting experience, including account reconciliations and month-end close tasks

• Experience supporting US companies or clients, whether through an outsourced accounting firm, a CPA or bookkeeping firm, or an in-house role

• Working knowledge of US GAAP and solid accrual accounting fundamentals

• Experience with at least one accounting system, such as QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, or Xero

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and attention to detail

• Strong written and spoken English for daily work with US teams



Preferred



• Exposure to an ERP or accounting system migration

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• CPA, ACCA, or equivalent (completed or in progress)



Who This Role Is For



An accountant who keeps the details right, asks questions early, and wants to grow into a specialist in financial data and ERP migrations.



Why Join Through MAVI



• Partner directly with department heads and finance leadership at a high-growth US consumer brand

• Build a combined accounting and FP&A profile, the foundation for senior finance roles

• Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll

• USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope

• Progress toward Senior Finance Manager, FP&A Manager, and Finance Manager opportunities through MAVI



Work Arrangement



This is a fully remote role with a single client company for the duration of the engagement. Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET); part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About MAVI



MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.



We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.



The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.



Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.



The Role



We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to own the monthly close and core financial reporting of a high-growth US company, working remotely from Philippines.



This is not a task-execution role. You will own a complete accounting workstream from the first journal entry to the final reconciliation, and you will be accountable for the accuracy of what leaves your hands. Where the close relies on manual workarounds or undocumented steps, you will be expected to fix them rather than repeat them.



You will work directly with the Controller, finance leadership, and the US stakeholders who rely on your numbers. A meaningful part of the role is explaining material movements clearly and flagging risks before they become late adjustments.

Because you will be working remotely with a lean US finance team, the role calls for someone who manages their own calendar, communicates proactively, and resolves issues without waiting to be asked.



What You'll Own



The Close and Reporting



1. The close: Own the month-end and year-end close for one or more entities, including the checklist, deadlines, and quality of output.

2. Journal entries and schedules: Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue, and fixed asset schedules with clear supporting documentation.

3. Reconciliations: Own balance sheet reconciliations, resolving reconciling items rather than carrying them forward.

4. Financial statements: Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow support under US GAAP, and explain the movements behind them.

5. Flux analysis: Investigate unusual movements, identify root causes, and explain the financial statement impact to leadership.



Controls and Audit Readiness



1. Audit-ready support: Maintain schedules and documentation that an auditor or reviewer can follow without a walkthrough.

2. Process improvement: Improve close checklists, SOPs, and recurring workflows so each close runs faster and cleaner than the last.

3. Audit and tax support: Prepare PBC requests and the accounting inputs external CPA firms depend on.



Accounting Operations and Partnership



1. Transactional review: Review AP, AR, payroll, and expense activity for correct coding, cut-off, and accrual treatment.

2. Stakeholder communication: Communicate directly with US finance leaders, surfacing risks, dependencies, and open items early.

3. Systems: Work within the company's ERP and finance tools, and identify opportunities for automation.



What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience with meaningful ownership of the month-end close

- Hands-on experience with US GAAP, supporting US companies, US entities, or international businesses that report under US GAAP

- Strong accrual accounting fundamentals; candidates with transferable PFRS or IFRS experience and practical US-client exposure will also be considered

- Experience preparing the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow support

- Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842)

- ERP experience with QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, or a comparable system; familiarity with tools such as Ramp, Brex, 
, or Gusto is an advantage

- Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

- The ability to own a workstream independently, investigate root causes, and resolve issues before they need senior escalation

- Experience working remotely with US-based stakeholders

- Excellent written and verbal English

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field



Preferred



- Philippine CPA (PRC-licensed), US CPA, ACCA, or equivalent (completed or in progress)

- Big 4 or public accounting experience, or experience at a firm serving US clients

- Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company

- Multi-entity or intercompany accounting exposure

- SaaS, e-commerce, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience



Who This Role Is For



This role suits an accountant who is ready to own the close outright rather than contribute one piece of it.



You care about getting the number right and about why it moved. You fix a broken process instead of working around it, and you are comfortable raising an issue with a US finance leader before they find it themselves.



Why Join Through MAVI



- Own a complete close for a high-growth US company, with direct exposure to US finance leadership

- Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities

- Build a track record of independent ownership, not task execution

- Progress toward Lead Accountant and Accounting Manager opportunities through MAVI

- USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope

- Receive MAVI's support throughout placement, onboarding, and the engagement that follows



Work Arrangement



This is a fully remote role. You will work directly with US-based finance leadership, and you will be placed with a single client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts.

Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET). Part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours. The rest of your schedule is arranged around your local working day.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support), as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

• Preferred: Cyber Security education/experience

• Preferred: Hyper-V experience



Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more



HOW TO APPLY?



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "L2 Tech Support - August 2026".



In your
 body, you MUST include the following, and ONLY the following, please:

- An attachment of your resume in PDF format (Please update your resume before submitting it, as we use an AI-powered agent to review qualifications.)

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you have a 100% clean background with no criminal history.

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you understand the business hours (MST\ Arizona time zone.



Answer the following questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have working in an MSP company? Name of the MSP company/s you worked with.

2. Do you have at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role?

3. Do you have experience working with RMM and PSA software? What applications did you use?

4. Do you have experience working with Virtualization, servers, GPO, TCP/IP, hyper-v/vmware, conditional access, Intune, and Scripting such as PowerShell?

5. Have you recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more? What time zone and when?

6. Are you okay with the computer requirements and the rental arrangement described in the job details?

7. Do you have an internet speed of at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ upload speed?



- No other information/cover letter or attachments should be included, besides a simple salutation and signature if so desired.



NOTE: Please do NOT apply using other methods besides the above. Any applicants who reach out to us via phone, social media, or any method other than the instructions above will automatically be disqualified.

Only those who followed the above instructions will be contacted within 2 business days, with further instructions.





We're looking forward to having you join our family!

title: Wildlife Video Editor – Part-Time | Solara Safaris
description:
I run Solara Safaris, a travel company specialising in exclusive small-group wildlife and photography expeditions.



I am looking for a creative, reliable video editor to transform my original wildlife footage into compelling content for Instagram,
 and YouTube, including video creatives for paid Meta advertising.



Our content should capture authentic wildlife encounters, give potential guests a sense of our expeditions and inspire them to discover more.



I am looking for someone who understands wildlife storytelling, has a strong eye for detail and can develop a consistent working relationship with me over time.



This is a video-editing role. Photo editing and advertising campaign management are not required.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Wildlife video editing

- Review original wildlife footage and independently select the strongest moments.

- Edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Edit longer YouTube videos with compelling storytelling, thoughtful pacing and strong openings.

- Recognise when a single animal encounter can carry an entire video rather than combining unrelated clips.

- Apply natural colour correction, exposure adjustments, stabilisation and noise reduction where needed.

- Add accurate English captions, subtitles and tasteful titles.

- Incorporate natural sound and appropriately licensed music.

- Create alternative openings or variations when requested.



Social media and advertising creatives

- Produce video creatives suitable for paid
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Adapt videos for Reels, Stories and feed placements.

- Prepare 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 versions where appropriate.

- Maintain safe areas for text, logos and important visual elements.

- Create simple closing frames using Solara's original logo and brand colours.

- Export videos in the correct formats, resolutions and compression settings.



You will not be responsible for setting up, managing or optimising advertising campaigns.



General

- Keep original footage, editable project files and final exports organised.

- Make revisions based on feedback.

- Maintain a consistent visual identity across our content.

- Deliver completed work within agreed deadlines.



OUR VISUAL STYLE



Our films should feel natural, cinematic and immersive.



We want the viewer to experience the wildlife moment, not the editing.



You should understand when a video needs energy and when an animal encounter deserves time to unfold.



We value:

- Natural colours and realistic detail.

- Thoughtful storytelling and pacing.

- Careful selection of wildlife behaviour and meaningful moments.

- Subtle transitions and effective sound design.

- Respect for the authenticity of the original footage.



We do not want excessive saturation, aggressive sharpening, artificial-looking animal details or unnecessary effects.



AI-generated wildlife imagery and artificially reconstructed animal details are not permitted.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- A strong video-editing portfolio showing both short-form and longer videos.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional software.

- Excellent storytelling and clip-selection skills.

- Strong colour-correction, stabilisation and audio-editing abilities.

- Experience creating content for Instagram,
 and YouTube.

- Knowledge of current video formats, aspect ratios, safe zones and export requirements.

- Ability to work with original 4K footage.

- Good written English for communication and on-screen text.

- Reliable communication, organisation and the ability to meet deadlines.



Experience editing wildlife, nature or documentary footage is a strong advantage.



Experience producing video creatives for paid social advertising is welcome, but managing advertising campaigns is not part of this role.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote, part-time position.

- Approximately 10 hours per week.

- Typically two to three short wildlife videos per week, plus occasional advertising creatives.

- Longer YouTube projects may be scheduled separately depending on the workload.



We will begin with a small paid editing test.



I will provide the original footage and creative direction, and I will review and approve all finished content before publication.



All supplied footage is confidential and may not be published, shared or used in a portfolio without my written permission.



Deliverables include final exports and editable video project files.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A brief introduction explaining why this role interests you.

2. Three relevant video examples, preferably including wildlife, nature, travel or documentary content.

3. At least one short-form social media video and one longer video demonstrating storytelling.

4. Your availability and hourly rate.



Please start your application with the word **LYNX** so I know you have read the full description.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test using original Solara Safaris wildlife footage. The assignment, fee and deadline will be confirmed before the test begins.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Our company is seeking a driven, energetic, and results-oriented Business Development Specialist to join our growing sales team. This role is ideal for a confident English communicator who thrives on building relationships, creating opportunities, and generating new business.



As the first point of contact with prospective clients, you will be responsible for conducting high-volume outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, and other outreach strategies. You will make approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day while leveraging HubSpot CRM to manage leads, track activity, and nurture prospects.



You will engage directly with CEOs, business owners, executives, and business brokers, introducing our services, identifying business needs, and scheduling qualified appointments for our sales team. Success in this role requires resilience, professionalism, curiosity, and the ability to build trust quickly through meaningful conversations.



Candidates must possess exceptional spoken and written English communication skills. Previous experience in B2B sales is required.



Key Responsibilities

• Conduct approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day to prospective clients.

• Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email campaigns, and outbound prospecting.

• Engage CEOs, business owners, executives, and brokers in professional, consultative conversations.

• Present HR Partners' services and value proposition compellingly and professionally.

• Identify customer needs, qualify prospects, and schedule high-quality appointments for the sales team.

• Maintain accurate prospect records, call activity, notes, and follow-up tasks within HubSpot CRM.

• Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through consistent daily outreach.

• Follow established sales processes while achieving daily, weekly, and monthly activity goals.

• Collaborate with the sales team to share market insights and improve prospect engagement strategies.

• Represent HR Partners with professionalism, integrity, and a customer-first mindset.



Qualifications

• Experience using HubSpot CRM or similar customer relationship management software is preferred.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in outbound B2B sales, appointment setting, or business development.

• Demonstrated success in high-volume cold calling and lead generation.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with a clear, professional, and confident speaking voice.

• Ability to confidently communicate with C-suite executives, business owners, and decision-makers.

• Strong relationship-building, active listening, and objection-handling skills.

• Self-motivated, resilient, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail.

• Experience selling HR outsourcing, payroll, benefits, insurance, or other business services is highly preferred.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free home office if working remotely.

• Ability to work during United States Eastern Time business hours.



Work Schedule

• Monday through Friday

• 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST)

• This is a full-time position. Candidates must be available to work during EST business hours.



Performance Expectations

• Complete approximately 150 outbound cold calls each business day.

• Consistently meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly outbound activity and appointment-setting goals.

• Maintain accurate and timely CRM documentation.

• Deliver a professional and engaging customer experience during every interaction.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

• Contribute to the continued growth of the sales organization through consistent prospecting and relationship building.



What Success Looks Like

The successful business development specialist is energetic, coachable, highly motivated, and enjoys speaking with new people every day. They are comfortable handling objections, persistent without being pushy, and focused on creating opportunities that help the sales team close new business. They embrace accountability, consistently exceed activity goals, and contribute to the company's long-term growth by generating qualified appointments and fostering strong business relationships.

title: Booking, Billing & Payroll Specialist
description:
# Booking, Billing & Payroll Specialist



**Position Overview**



Spectrum Florida Security is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented Booking, Billing & Payroll Specialist to manage the administrative and financial processes involved in securing new business, booking security services, preparing estimates, invoicing clients, and processing employee payroll.



This position is responsible for ensuring that client bookings are properly documented, services are accurately priced and billed, and employees are paid correctly and on time.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Booking & Scheduling**

- Process new client service requests and bookings.

- Confirm service dates, times, locations, and staffing requirements.

- Coordinate bookings with the operations and scheduling departments.

- Ensure all approved bookings are entered into company systems.

- Maintain accurate client and service records.



**2. Estimates & Proposals**

- Prepare estimates for new and existing clients.

- Calculate hourly, weekly, monthly, and annual service costs.

- Coordinate pricing and rates with management.

- Prepare and send proposals for client approval.

- Follow up on outstanding estimates and approvals.

- Ensure approved pricing is reflected in the final service agreement.



**3. Invoicing & Accounts Receivable**

- Prepare and send client invoices through QuickBooks.

- Ensure invoices accurately reflect approved rates and hours worked.

- Track outstanding invoices and payment deadlines.

- Follow up with clients regarding overdue payments.

- Maintain accurate billing records.

- Reconcile invoices against schedules and completed services.



**4. Payroll Processing**

- Collect and verify employee timesheets and hours worked.

- Audit attendance, overtime, and pay rates.

- Prepare payroll reports and payroll submissions.

- Ensure payroll matches approved schedules and actual hours worked.

- Coordinate payroll corrections and discrepancies.

- Maintain accurate payroll records.

- Ensure employees are paid accurately and on schedule.



**5. Administrative & Financial Reporting**

- Maintain organized digital records and documentation.

- Reconcile bookings, estimates, invoices, and payroll records.

- Prepare weekly reports for management.

- Identify billing discrepancies and prevent missed revenue.

- Assist with administrative improvements and automation.



### Required Qualifications

- Previous experience in payroll, bookkeeping, billing, or administrative operations.

- Experience with QuickBooks preferred.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to manage multiple deadlines.

- Strong written and verbal communication.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and employee information.



### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with security companies, staffing agencies, or service-based businesses.

- Experience with employee scheduling and timekeeping software.

- Familiarity with Connecteam and payroll processing.

- Experience reconciling invoices against employee timesheets.



### Performance Expectations (KPIs)

- 100% payroll accuracy.

- 100% of approved services properly booked and documented.

- Estimates prepared and delivered within established company deadlines.

- 100% of completed services invoiced accurately.

- Daily reconciliation of hours, bookings, and billing records.

- No missed payroll deadlines.

- Consistent follow-up on outstanding client invoices.



**Primary Objective:** Ensure every service booked by Spectrum is properly priced, documented, invoiced, and paid for, while ensuring every employee is accurately compensated and paid on time.

title: Remote Dispatch & Client Care Associate (Part-Time, US Pacific Hours)
description:
A mobile concierge wellness company is looking for a part-time dispatch and client care associate to join its remote team. A network of mobile infusion nurses delivers IV therapy and wellness treatments to clients at home, in hotels and at offices. You'll be the first voice our clients hear.



A large share of our clients are returning clients and members who book with us again and again. They expect to be recognized, remembered and looked after. Impeccable customer service is the heart of this role.



About the role

This is a calm, low-volume role: mostly inbound calls, up to 15 to 20 per shift, plus a lot of real-time logistical support for the nurses in the field and support for the medical providers who do client intakes. You'll report to our dispatch supervisor. The number one priority of this role is answering the phone: striving for a 100% answer rate, every call picked up within the first three rings. After that, it's care and precision: clients looked after, and bookings entered exactly right.



What you'll do

- Handle inbound client calls, texts and messages with warmth, speed and accuracy

- Turn inquiries into booked appointments and keep client records and payments accurate

- Coordinate and support the nurses in the field: scheduling, routing, logistics and real-time problem-solving

- Support the medical providers with client intake

- Monitor our dispatch and routing tools so every visit stays on track

- Give returning clients and members personalized, five-star service every time

- Follow our privacy, documentation and hand-off protocols between shifts



Must have

- Front desk or reception experience at a cash-based practice, such as a medical spa, aesthetic clinic, IV or wellness clinic, or concierge medicine practice

- HIPAA certified, or previously certified and able to obtain a new certification before starting

- Impeccable spoken and written English, with clear enunciation on the phone

- A track record of impeccable, personalized customer service, ideally with returning or VIP clients and members

- Telemarketing or phone sales experience

- Must be tech savvy and familiar with a CRM, a POS, a VoIP phone system, Google Workspace, Slack and Trello

- You learn new software fast and work across several apps at once

- Speed to lead and strong attention to detail

- Reliable: on time for every shift



A plus

- Certified medical receptionist or medical administrative assistant credential

- Spanish, for our Los Angeles clients



Not the right fit if your experience is only at large health systems, hospitals or insurance-billing offices. This is a small, fast-moving, cash-based service business. We're looking for someone who has worked directly with private-pay clients.



What you need

- A reliable computer and a dedicated, stable internet connection of at least 75 Mbps, with a backup option (a speed test screenshot will be requested)

- A quality headset with a microphone

- A secure, private, dedicated work location where calls can't be overheard and screens can't be seen by others

- Must be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays. We're open 365 days a year, and the dispatch team covers 6:30 am to 10:00 or 11:00 pm Pacific time, every day. We especially need Saturday mornings (7:00 am to 2:00 pm Pacific) and evenings (8:30 pm to 11:00 pm Pacific)



Pay and trial

- $6.00 to $8.00 USD per hour based on experience, plus potential bonuses

- Paid twice a month

- Part time to start (about 15 to 25 hours a week), with room to grow

- Paid 2-week trial, starting with a shadow shift alongside an experienced team member



How to apply

Apply through this posting. Send your CV, a short note about your front desk and customer service experience (tell us the type of practice), your time zone and the shifts you can work, plus a 1-minute voice recording introducing yourself. Applications without a CV and a voice recording won't be reviewed.



No AI tools. This role handles private client and health information, so AI tools of any kind (chatbots, AI writing, note-taking or transcription tools, AI browser assistants) may not be used to do this job. This is a firm rule.

title: B2B SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT LEAD
description:
B2B SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER

US Market | Corporate Gifting & Promotional Products



Employment Type: Full-time  

Compensation: US$1,500/month base salary + commission (negotiable based on experience)  

Schedule:  Must be available to overlap with US business hours  

Location:  Remote – Philippines



***********************************

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



Are you an experienced B2B sales professional who knows how to find prospects, make cold calls, build relationships, negotiate, and close deals?



SurviveX is looking for a results-driven B2B Sales & Business Development professional to help expand our presence in the US corporate market.



We manufacture first-aid kits and are developing a new sales channel focused on corporate gifting, promotional products, and branded merchandise.



You don't necessarily need previous experience in corporate gifting. What matters most is your proven ability to generate your own leads, engage business decision-makers, manage sales opportunities, and turn prospects into paying customers.



Experience in corporate gifting or promotional products is a strong advantage, but we are equally interested in successful B2B sales professionals from other industries who can bring transferable sales experience and a strong closing track record.



This is an ownership-driven, full-cycle sales position. You will be responsible for developing your own prospecting strategy, identifying potential buyers, conducting outreach, managing sales conversations, negotiating deals, and closing business.



You will help build a new US sales channel rather than simply follow an existing sales process.



********IMPORTANT****** 

This is NOT an appointment-setting, sales support, or order-processing role. We need someone who has personally generated business and closed deals.



***********************************

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Business Development: Identify target markets, industries, potential buyers, and new B2B sales opportunities in the US.

2. Lead Generation: Research and build qualified prospect lists through LinkedIn,
, cold calling, referrals, and other outbound channels.

3. Cold Outreach & Sales Conversations: Initiate contact with US-based business owners, corporate buyers, procurement teams, marketing departments, and other decision-makers.

4. Needs Assessment: Understand customer requirements, purchasing budgets, order quantities, customization needs, and delivery timelines.

5. Full-Cycle Sales Management: Prepare proposals and quotations, present solutions, handle objections, negotiate terms, and personally close deals.

6. Account Development: Build long-term client relationships, develop repeat business, and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.

7. Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate sales records, monitor follow-ups, track conversion rates, forecast opportunities, and report sales performance.

8. Channel Development: Help establish and improve SurviveX's approach to selling corporate gifting and promotional products in the US market.



***********************************

QUALIFICATIONS



**Required Experience and Skills**



- Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or corporate account acquisition.

- Hands-on experience with cold calling, outbound prospecting, and lead generation.

- Demonstrated ability to personally negotiate and close sales.

- Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing and account development.

- Strong spoken and written English, with confidence communicating with US-based business decision-makers.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of sales targets, and develop opportunities without constant supervision.

- Strong follow-up, negotiation, relationship-building, and pipeline management skills.



*****Nice to Have (Not Required)*****



- Experience in US corporate gifting, promotional products, branded merchandise, or corporate merchandise.

- Experience selling to US companies, distributors, HR departments, marketing teams, or procurement departments.

- Familiarity with corporate purchasing processes, bulk orders, and customized products.

- Experience using industry platforms such as SAGE, ESP, or commonSKU.



**We welcome experienced B2B sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate a strong track record of personally generating and closing deals.**



***********************************

COMPENSATION & GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



- Base salary: US$1,500 per month + commission.

- Commission arrangements are negotiable based on experience.

- Opportunity to take ownership of a growing US sales channel.

- Direct contribution to the company's sales strategy, client acquisition, and revenue growth.



***********************************

HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1.  Link to your CV/Resume: Include your relevant sales and business development experience.

2. Link to you Portfolio or Sales Track Record: Share examples of deals, accounts, or business opportunities you have personally generated and closed.

3. Link to your Sales Results Summary: Provide 2–3 bullet points highlighting your sales achievements. Include the industry, period covered, approximate deal values or results, and your individual contribution. Experience in corporate gifting is welcome, but B2B sales results from other industries are also accepted.

4.  REQUIRED Recorded Video Introduction: Submit a 5–8 minute Loom video or similar recording covering:

   - One real B2B deal you personally sourced and closed (any industry).

   - How you identified prospects and generated leads.

   - Your approach to cold calling and handling rejection or stalled opportunities.

   - How you manage your sales pipeline and follow-ups.

   - How you would approach your first 30 days building a new US corporate sales channel.



Please anonymize clients and protect confidential information. We are interested in your actual sales experience, ownership, and approach—not polished video production.



Also indicate your availability and ability to work with US business hours.



***********************************



We are looking for someone who knows how to sell, not just someone who knows the industry.



If you can open doors, build business relationships, turn prospects into customers, and consistently close deals, we would like to hear from you!

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Our client is a 7-figure US DTC supplement brand selling on Shopify and Amazon. They spend six figures a month on ads, ship physical inventory, and run subscriptions. They are looking for an E-commerce Bookkeeper to keep their books clean every single week, so the numbers they make decisions on are numbers they can trust.



This role starts part-time at 20 hours per week, with a plan to grow it into a full-time finance role for the right person. The ideal candidate is the kind of bookkeeper who spots the numbers that don’t match and won’t let it go until they do.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week, with potential to grow into a full-time finance role

Location: Remote

Timezone: Eastern Standard Time (EST)

Compensation: 7 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Weekly Bookkeeping

Categorise and reconcile all bank, credit card, and PayPal transactions in QuickBooks Online

Reconcile Shopify payouts and Amazon settlements back to bank deposits

Tag every expense to the correct category in the client’s internal finance dashboard, with a goal of zero untagged items each week

Prepare bills for payment, including supplier invoices, agency invoices, and contractor pay, for founder approval and payment

Track refunds and chargebacks so their true cost is clearly visible

Monthly Close & Reporting

Close the books by the 10th of each month, with every account reconciled and the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement completed

Keep COGS accurate using landed cost per unit, including product, freight, duties, and fulfillment



Required Skills & Experience



All of the following are required:



Experience: 2+ years of bookkeeping for e-commerce or DTC brands specifically (general small business or single retail store experience does not qualify)

QuickBooks Online: Strong proficiency, including reconciliations, rules, classes, journal entries, and month-end close

Shopify Reconciliation: Has reconciled Shopify payouts and understands their components, including gross sales, refunds, discounts, fees, chargebacks, and reserves

Inventory & COGS: Solid understanding of landed cost, inventory as an asset, and expensing cost when product sells

Communication: Fluent written English, with questions and reports clear enough to need no follow-up call

Reliability: Consistent and dependable, with books completed on schedule every week without being chased

title: AI Video Editor & Creative Specialist | Meta Ads | E-commerce Brand
description:
About Finex



Finex is a fast-growing European e-commerce brand specializing in smart home security products, including video doorbells, security cameras, and smart door locks.



We're constantly looking for new ways to push our creative marketing forward. We invest heavily in direct-response advertising on Meta 
 & Instagram), and we're now looking to take our AI-generated content to the next level.



We believe AI is opening up huge opportunities for creative advertising, and we want to be at the forefront of it.



That's why we're looking for a highly creative and experienced AI Video Editor who can help us produce unique, engaging, and high-converting video ads.



What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply edits videos or adds AI effects to existing footage.



We're looking for someone who knows how to use AI to create entirely new advertising concepts.



Someone who loves experimenting with new AI tools, understands what makes people stop scrolling, and can turn creative ideas into compelling video ads.



We want to explore everything AI has to offer, including:



Hyper-realistic AI-generated videos that look like real footage.



AI-generated UGC-style content, characters, and storytelling.



Cartoon-style and animated AI advertisements.



Creative AI videos featuring original songs, music, and catchy jingles.



Unique visual concepts that would be difficult or expensive to produce traditionally.



Different hooks, marketing angles, and variations for Meta Ads.



Combining real product footage with AI-generated environments, characters, and scenes.

 and Instagram.

Turn marketing angles and ideas into engaging direct-response video ads.

Stay updated on the latest AI video-generation tools and techniques.

Proven experience creating high-quality AI-generated videos.



A strong portfolio showcasing AI video projects.



Experience creating ads for e-commerce or direct-response brands.



Understanding of Meta Ads and performance marketing.



Ability to create realistic AI videos with natural-looking movement, characters, and environments.



Experience with AI animation, cartoons, or creative storytelling.



Strong video editing skills, including sound design, pacing, captions, and transitions.



Ability to work independently and contribute creative ideas.



Good English communication skills.



Experience with tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, Sora, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Suno, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools is a big plus.



We care much more about the quality of your work than which specific tools you use.



What Makes This Opportunity Different?



At Finex, we don't want to use AI just because it's trending.



We want to use AI to create advertising that genuinely stands out and drives results.



You'll have the opportunity to experiment with different styles, develop original concepts, and help shape how we use AI in our advertising strategy.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, experiment constantly, and become an important part of our creative team.



If you love AI, creative advertising, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Your portfolio: Share your best AI-generated video projects. We especially want to see work you've created for other e-commerce or direct-response brands advertising on Meta.



Relevant experience: Tell us which brands you've worked with and what type of AI ads you've created for them.



Your favorite AI tools: Which tools do you use, and what makes them your preferred choice?



Your creative approach: How would you use AI to help an e-commerce brand test more advertising angles and creative variations?



Your availability and expected monthly salary.



Important: Applications without an AI video portfolio will not be considered.



We're particularly interested in seeing realistic AI video ads, animated/cartoon ads, and creative concepts that have actually been used in paid advertising.



If you have performance results from your previous creatives, we'd love to see those too.



Let's create the next generation of performance ads together.



Finex Creative Team

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Unexplained Events & Mysteries
description:
I’m looking for an excellent, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about unusual encounters, strange sightings, and unexplained events.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must handle each script independently, including research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Every script must be finished and ready for narration when you submit it. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I want a strong opening, events presented in a clear order, and interesting details that hold the listener’s attention. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’d like to find a dependable writer for a long-term working relationship.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Strange Encounters & Compelling Mysteries
description:
We're looking for an excellent, independent writer to create compelling YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unusual encounters, and unexplained events.



THE STANDARD WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a writer who can create scripts on the level of MrBallen and Lighthouse Mysteries. These two channels illustrate the storytelling standard we want: compelling stories, natural language, strong pacing, and details that keep you listening from beginning to end.



We want someone who can turn a fascinating mystery into a complete, engaging script. Someone who knows what to include, what to leave out, and how to make each part of the story interesting. The opening should draw listeners in, and the writing needs to hold their attention all the way to the ending.



We've been looking for the right writer for a while. The problems we keep encountering are repetition, boring stretches, unnatural wording, and scripts that need substantial rewriting before they can be narrated. We need the judgment and attention to detail to deliver polished work independently.



For the right writer, this could become a long-term role with regular assignments. We'd like to build an ongoing working relationship with someone whose scripts we're excited to read.



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• We provide the topic and writing guidelines for each assignment.



THE ROLE



For paid assignments, you will handle research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading independently. Each finished script needs to be ready to narrate as written, without us having to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



Topics include strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Stories should have safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts should be extremely easy to follow and natural when read aloud, as though you're telling a friend a fascinating story. We want a strong opening, events presented in a clear chronological order, and interesting details that hold attention throughout.



Plain language is essential. No flowery descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive. For example:



• Instead of “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town,” use “The town was quiet.”

• Instead of “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt,” use “The moon lit the road.”

• Instead of “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure,” use “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, repeated points, or padding. Build suspense through the events and details of the story.



Paid scripts must be carefully researched and include source links. Documented facts, witness accounts, and speculation should be presented accurately. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line and include:



1. A brief introduction and any relevant writing experience.

2. Your strongest existing script that demonstrates this level of storytelling. A complete script lets us see how you carry the story from its opening through to its ending. Identify exactly what you wrote and make sure the link is accessible.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



We're looking for a dependable writer with serious attention to detail and the ability to consistently deliver engaging, narration-ready scripts.

title: Social Media Ads Graphic Designer
description:
We're Not Hiring Someone to Simply "Make Pretty Ads."

We're Hiring Someone Who Designs Ads That Stop the Scroll, Communicate in Seconds, and Get Better With Every Round of Data.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per two-week period in USD, based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every two weeks. Approximately 80 hours per pay period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Team Scope: Designs paid social creative for multiple ecommerce client brands, working closely with the media buyer, copywriting, and creative teams



Why This Role Exists

Most paid social ads do not fail because they look bad.

They fail because:

The hook does not stop the scroll

The message takes too long to understand

The product, offer, or benefit gets lost in the design

The ad looks like an ad, and people skip it

The same creative runs until it is exhausted

One concept gets made once instead of tested in several variations

Designers never see the performance data, so the next round repeats the same mistakes



At EcomIgnyte, we run paid media for multiple ecommerce brands across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and other platforms. Creative is the biggest lever in every one of those ad accounts. We want ads that are:

Scroll-stopping

Clear in under three seconds

Native to each platform

On-brand

Built in testable variations

Improved by real performance data



We're hiring a Paid Social Ad Designer who can turn briefs and performance insights into high volumes of clean, conversion-focused ad creative, and who gets better with every round of results.



This role exists so:

The media buyer always has fresh creative ready to test

Every concept is produced in enough variations to find a winner

Winning ads are iterated on quickly before they fatigue

Each platform gets creative built for how people use it

Brands stay consistent across every ad and format

Performance data shapes every new round of design



This is not about making trendy graphics.

It is about designing ads that get attention, communicate fast, and drive action.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

You will not only be making ads. You will help d
 what every brand's paid social creative says, how it looks, and what gets tested next.

Ad Creative Production

Design static ads for Meta 
 and Instagram), TikTok, Pinterest, and other paid social platforms

Create ads in every size and placement needed: feed, stories, reels, and carousels

Turn creative briefs, copy, and product photos into clean, scroll-stopping ads

Design common ecommerce ad formats, such as product benefit ads, offer and promo ads, before-and-after, comparison, testimonial and review ads, UGC-style graphics, and "us vs. them" layouts

Edit and resize product images and lifestyle photos for ad use

Create simple motion graphics or edit short video hooks when needed

Variations and Iteration

Produce multiple variations of each concept, such as different hooks, headlines, visuals, offers, and layouts

Iterate on winning ads quickly so the media buyer can keep scaling them

Refresh fatigued creative with new angles while keeping what worked

Adapt one campaign concept across several platforms and formats

Working From Data

Review performance feedback from the media buyer on which ads are winning and why

Learn which hooks, layouts, and visual styles perform best for each brand

Use those learnings to make every new round of creative stronger

Suggest your own creative ideas and angles worth testing

Organization and Quality

Follow brand guidelines for every client

Build reusable ad templates and components in Figma

Check every ad for spelling, alignment, readability, safe zones, and platform text and size requirements

Name, organize, and export files so the media buyer can launch them without guessing

Organize briefs, revisions, feedback, and approvals inside ClickUp



You are not expected to run the ads.

You are expected to:

Think about what makes someone stop scrolling

Communicate one clear message per ad

Produce high volumes of quality creative on deadline

Design for each platform, not one size for all

Learn from performance data instead of personal taste

Work across several brands without losing consistency



This Role Is for Someone Who…

Has designed paid social ads for ecommerce brands

Understands that an ad has about three seconds to get attention

Has strong instincts for hierarchy, contrast, typography, and layout

Can make one idea work across many sizes, formats, and variations

Is comfortable designing in Figma, and in Photoshop or Canva when needed

Is fast without being sloppy

Wants to see performance data and enjoys learning what actually works

Can work within existing brand guidelines

Can take a clear brief and deliver, and asks questions when a brief is not clear

Accepts losing ads as useful learning, not failure

Can take feedback without ego

Communicates clearly and works well inside organized systems



This Role Is Not for Someone Who…

Only designs for how things look, not how they perform

Struggles to produce volume on deadline

Gets attached to one version and resists testing alternatives

Ignores platform specs, safe zones, or brand guidelines

Is "almost fluent" in English

Experience That Helps

Paid social ad design for Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, or Snapchat

Ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brands

Creative testing and producing ad variations

Figma components and reusable templates

Photoshop for product image editing and retouching

Simple motion design or short video editing (After Effects, CapCut, Premiere Pro)

UGC-style and native-looking ad formats

Working with media buyers, copywriters, and performance teams

Agency or multi-brand work

ClickUp or similar project management tools



You do not need to be a "creative genius."

You do need:

Strong design instincts

Attention to detail

Marketing awareness

Speed and consistency

The ability to learn from performance data

The discipline to follow briefs, brand standards, and feedback



How You'll Work With the Team

The media buyer runs the ads and reads the data. They give you creative briefs, testing needs, and performance feedback, and you turn that into new concepts, variations, and iterations.

The copywriting team provides hooks, headlines, and angles. You organize that copy visually so the message lands in seconds.

The creative and website teams provide brand assets, product photos, and guidelines. You keep every ad consistent with the brand.

The project manager keeps work moving in ClickUp. You keep your tasks, revisions, and deliverables up to date so nothing gets stuck.

You are not designing in isolation. You are part of a system built to find winning creative faster and scale it across every client brand.



Why You'll Like Working Here

A variety of ecommerce brands and creative challenges

Real performance data on the ads you design

A media buyer who gives you clear briefs and honest feedback

A steady pipeline of creative work

Clear workflows and expectations

Organized project management

Leadership that values thoughtful, performance-driven design

Long-term opportunities for growth

A team that cares about quality, clarity, and execution



We do not reward decoration.

We reward clarity, speed, strong creative judgment, and ads that prove themselves in the numbers.

Application Process



PLEASE DO NOT JUST REPLY TO THIS POST ON THE JOB BOARD. To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.

Step 1: Take a Short Online IQ Test

We respect intelligence, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

Go to the Fast Learner Free IQ Test

Complete the test

Create a free account at the end

Save your results URL for Step 3

Applicants without a valid results link will not be considered.



Step 2: Record a Two-to-Three-Minute Loom Video

Camera must be on. Create a free Loom account and record a short introduction in clear English.

Tell us:

About your experience designing paid social ads, especially for ecommerce brands

Which platforms you have designed for (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, others)

What makes an ad stop the scroll and communicate quickly

How you create variations of one ad concept for testing

An ad you designed that performed well, and why you think it worked

Your experience with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or video editing tools

Why you believe this role would be a good fit

Save the Loom URL for Step 3.



Step 3: Complete the Online Interview

The Google Form is your online interview. No AI-generated answers. We want to hear from you.

In the application form:

Enter your contact details

Paste your IQ test results link

Paste your Loom video link

Upload your resume

Share your portfolio of ad creative

Answer every question honestly and thoughtfully

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview

The final stage is a live video interview with your camera on. This is where we learn more about how you think, communicate, respond to feedback, and approach creative work.

Every completed application will be reviewed personally. Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be contacted directly.

If this role speaks to you, good. That probably means you care about more than decoration.

Bring your best work.

We'll bring the data.

title: Amazon Operations Manager
description:
THE ROLE



We help 8- and 9-figure brands grow on Amazon. We’re hiring someone to own the operational work that needs judgment, checking, and follow-through. We are an AI-first company and we use AI agents and automations across all our work.



Your core work is troubleshooting Account Health, coordinating with the design team, making sure approved images and A+ are live correctly, owning our AI-assisted SEO workflow, and keeping task status accurate.



You’ll work with the founder and our advertising and design team.



YOUR MISSION



Keep our clients’ Amazon operations moving. Coordinate the handoff between design and Amazon, verify the approved work is live, and catch content that later breaks or changes. Own SEO and troubleshoot Account Health, especially for supplements.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



1. Account Health cases move forward.

You investigate the actual issue, gather the right evidence, prepare responses, follow up with Amazon, and verify the outcome. When a case needs specialist review or an owner decision, you bring the history and a recommended next action.



2. Design work reaches Amazon correctly and stays accurate.

Stay in touch with our designers, track what’s ready, and get approved images and A+ uploaded through our AI workflows or handle exceptions yourself. Compare what’s live with the approved designs and fix missing, old, or broken content, including later Amazon changes.



SEO stays with you. Run, check, apply, and verify it through our existing AI process.



3. Task status can be trusted.

The existing task system shows what is done, waiting on Amazon, blocked, and next. You use AI and notifications to help maintain it, check that it matches reality, and follow up before deadlines.



In your first 30 days, you’ll learn the accounts, workflows, approvals, and active cases. By day 60, we expect independent ownership of routine work and well-prepared escalations for complex cases. We’ll agree clear goals and deadlines that fit a realistic part-time workload.



WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING



- Hands-on Amazon Seller Central and Account Health troubleshooting experience. Show cases you personally handled, including what failed and what you did next.



- Experience with supplement-related Account Health, or strong evidence that you can learn it. If this category is new to you, you’ll need to demonstrate sound research and judgment in a practical case.



- Real operational AI experience beyond improving copy. Be ready to demonstrate a workflow, the output you checked, and a mistake or failure you caught.



- Consistent follow-through when Amazon or somebody else is slow to respond.



- An eye for detail: you spot differences between an approved design and what’s live, investigate them, and follow through on the fix.



- Clear spoken and written English for team updates and Amazon support calls/chats.



We’ll train you in our best practices, prompts, agents, and client workflows. We also hope you’ll bring experience that’s better than ours in some areas and teach us what we can improve.



Building new automations with AI is welcome. If that’s new to you, we’ll teach you. We haven’t found a fully reliable way to automate the design-to-live checks yet, so there’s a real problem to work on.



HOW WE WORK



We want you to use AI throughout your daily work. It won’t handle everything. You remain responsible for judgment, checking the results, and handling exceptions.



You’ll work remotely from the Philippines, starting at 20 hours per week, spread across five weekdays. We’ll agree on how to coordinate calls and time-sensitive Amazon cases.



There’s plenty of room to grow here, including beyond this role. You can take on more ownership and grow from part-time to full-time as the work grows.



We value ownership, honest updates, practical learning, and early action on risks.



WHY WORK WITH US



- Work remotely, when you’re most productive. We agree on goals and deadlines, with no fixed shifts or time tracking.



- Hands-on training in our Amazon best practices, AI agents, and building new automations with AI.



- Direct access to the founder and a team that wants to learn from your experience.



- Room to take on more ownership, grow beyond this role, and move from part-time to full-time as the work grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a short, personal message here telling me why this role interests you. Put OpsCheck in the subject or first line and keep your message under 150 words.



Please write it yourself, in your own words. No AI-written or copy-and-paste applications.

title: Virtual Assistant Amazon Influencer
description:

We are looking for an organized, motivated Virtual Assistant to help grow our Amazon Influencer business.
