title: Machinery and Parts Expert Content Marketer
description:
As a Content Marketer, your primary focus will be to create high-value, informative content that showcases expertise in machinery, their parts, and functionality. This role is ideal for someone with a mechanical background or experience in auto mechanics/repair, machinery, or parts handling who is also eager to grow in content marketing.



Let’s face it, today’s writing often involves AI, but foundational knowledge is key. If you don’t have the ability to critically assess AI-generated text, discern what makes sense, and edit it to resonate with real human readers, then this role isn’t for you. We’re looking for a writer with solid foundations, proficient in English, quick learner, and someone who’s excited to continuously improve. If this sounds like you, we’d love to see you apply.



Responsibilities

• Content Creation: Write and optimize content for various web pages, including product descriptions, Q&As, category pages, blogs, and informative articles.

• Research & Development: Conduct in-depth research about machinery and parts to understand and improve content quality, ensuring that each piece is accurate, valuable, and competitive.

• SEO & Competitive Analysis: Learn and apply SEO principles, analyze competitor content, and make our pages rank higher by providing truly superior information.

• Content Maintenance / Enhancement: Continuously improve existing content by adding images, videos, and other enhancements to make it more informative and engaging.

• Quality & Value Focus: Avoid "word salad" content and focus on delivering real value to users who need reliable information to make buying decisions.

• Tool Use: Work with tools like ChatGPT to ensure high standards in clarity and language.



Requirements

• Mechanical Expertise: Strong background or hands-on experience with parts, auto mechanics, or machines. We need someone who understands machine components and how they work.

• Writing Skills: A solid foundation in writing with excellent English language skills.

• Learning Mindset: Eager to learn, improve, and grow within a dynamic environment.

• Self-Learner: Able to work independently, particularly with online tools and resources.

• Continuous Improvement: Embrace constructive feedback, strive for excellence, and adapt to new challenges.

• SEO Knowledge: Not required, but a plus. We’re willing to train the right person who brings the right foundational skills.



Why Join Us?

• See the Impact: The content you create will directly influence sales and page rankings. You’ll see the fruits of your labor in real, measurable ways.

• Growth Opportunity: This is a long-term role where you’ll be part of a supportive, goal-oriented team with room for professional development.

• Team Culture: We value teamwork, continual learning, and pushing the boundaries.



Please answer the following questions as part of your job application screening:



1. Do you have another job (full-time or part-time)? If yes, are you planning on leaving? When can you start?

2. Are you able to work full-time (40 hours per week, Monday to Friday) during US business hours?

3. Describe any hands-on experience you have working with machines, auto mechanics, or machinery parts. What specific machines or components have you worked with?

4. Provide a sample of your writing that demonstrates your ability to explain a technical topic clearly and concisely. 



Please apply only if you feel confident in most of the areas described above. When submitting your application, make sure to answer all the screening questions. Only applications with completed screening questions will be considered.



If you’re excited to be a part of becoming the main supplier for every machinery part and contribute meaningful content that resonates with real-world users, we invite you to apply!



We look forward to seeing how you can make a difference at Abtra Inc. and to the rest of the world.

title: Personal Brand Social Media Manager & Short-Form Video Editor (Full Time, Remote)
description:
Remote | US hours overlap | Long-term role



This is a really exciting opportunity to be on the founding team of a top entrepreneur. We are looking for the best creatives: someone who understands content, lives and breathes content, and knows personal brand trends inside out. The founder is an authority in the creative operations space and is building her personal brand properly: a real content strategy, consistent short-form video, open experimentation, and a long-term seat for the person who wants to own this brand's growth, not just post clips.



THE WORK



You will be the content engine for a leading personal brand in the creative operations space. The founder is the product: her ideas, her businesses, her day to day building in public. Your job is to turn that into content people stop for, follow for, and share, and to build a personal brand that grows every single week.



You will work from a shared content calendar, plan and edit short-form video from raw footage, create variations to test what performs, and bring ideas every week: trends, hooks, series concepts, and the moments only a founder building in public can capture. Experimentation is part of the job: we test, we read the numbers, we double down on what works.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You are already someone who:



- HAS PERSONAL BRAND EXPERIENCE. You have managed or edited content for a personal brand, a coach, a founder, or an entrepreneur, and you can prove it with accounts and results. This is the headline requirement for this role

- Lives and breathes content: you study what performs, you spot personal brand trends early, and you always know what the best creators in the space are doing

- Edits strong short-form video (CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or similar): hooks in the first 3 seconds, tight pacing, clean captions, trending audio

- Understands personal brand content: story, point of view, and what makes a founder worth following

- Can run a content calendar without daily hand-holding: filming days, editing queue, posting schedule

- Loves open experimentation: testing hooks, formats, and series, then killing what does not work without ego

- Is reliable and communicative: flags problems early and hits deadlines without being chased

- Is available for US hours overlap



Bonus: you run your own personal brand, you have grown an account of your own, ManyChat or DM automation experience, YouTube long-form experience.



This is not for you if



- You have never worked on a personal brand, coach, founder, or creator account

- Your portfolio is only corporate, product, or wedding work

- You need shot-by-shot instructions for every edit



THE STANDARD



Sharp, premium, and unmistakably her. Every post sounds like the founder on her best day: clear point of view, real story, zero fluff. Sloppy captions, weak hooks, or generic content that any brand could post never ship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Run the content strategy and calendar: what is filming, what is editing, and what is posting each week

- Edit short-form Reels, TikToks, and Shorts from raw footage: talking head, day in the life, behind the scenes of building her businesses

- Build hooks in the first 1 to 3 seconds and create test variations to see what performs

- Post and schedule approved content, with captions written in the founder's voice

- Watch performance data and pitch stronger hooks, angles, and formats every week

- Track personal brand trends and bring the ones that fit before everyone else is doing them

- Keep footage, drafts, and finished videos organised in shared folders

- Support community and engagement in the brand voice where needed



WHY THIS ROLE



- A really exciting opportunity with a top personal brand: a founding team seat, real creative ownership, your ideas on screen, not just your edits

- One brand, long-term: you build the look, the rhythm, and the audience, and you watch your work perform

- Training, templates, and a clear content system provided

- A founder who is investing in her brand properly and wants this seat filled for the long run



HOURS



- Full time, 40 hours per week, US hours overlap

- Long-term role



HOW TO APPLY



We don't accept
s or DMs. Start your first answer with the word "Pink."



You'll be asked for:



- Links to 3 pieces of personal brand content you personally created or edited (direct links, not a portfolio homepage)

Location: Philippines

Company: US-Based Laundromat Business



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for an experienced, creative, and results-driven Marketing Director with at least 3 years of experience in a marketing leadership role to oversee marketing strategies and promotional campaigns across our growing network of laundromat locations in the United States.



The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of developing successful marketing strategies, managing campaigns, analyzing business performance, and driving customer acquisition and revenue growth.



We need someone who can take full ownership of our marketing initiatives, develop effective promotions, and coordinate advertising campaigns with our team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Marketing Management: Oversee marketing strategies and activities across all store locations.



2. Promotion Development: Plan and create promotions, special offers, seasonal campaigns, and customer incentives tailored to each location.



3. Advertising Coordination: Develop advertising concepts, promotional materials, and campaign instructions for our advertising team to execute.



4. Store Performance Analysis: Monitor individual store performance, identify underperforming locations, and recommend marketing improvements.



5. Marketing Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to attract new customers, improve customer retention, and increase revenue.



6. Campaign Planning: Create and manage monthly marketing calendars covering promotions, holidays, seasonal offers, and special events.



7. Team Coordination: Collaborate with advertising specialists, developers, and operations managers to ensure successful campaign execution.



8. Performance Tracking: Monitor advertising results, customer engagement, promotion redemptions, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).



9. Brand Consistency: Maintain consistent branding, messaging, and promotional standards across all locations.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Marketing Director or in a comparable senior marketing leadership role.

- Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

- Strong experience in managing marketing operations and coordinating advertising teams.

- Experience in customer acquisition, retention strategies, and revenue growth.

- Strong understanding of paid advertising, campaign performance, and marketing analytics.

- Ability to analyze business performance and make data-driven marketing decisions.

- Excellent leadership, project management, and organizational skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple projects remotely.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a results-driven mindset.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Previous experience working with US-based companies.

title: Dental Insurance & Billing Specialist
description:
Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics | Remote



Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Reports to: ROC Team Leader



About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing dental group in Los Angeles, California, with four offices offering general dentistry and orthodontics to kids, teens, and adults. Our Remote Operations Coordinators (ROCs) work behind the scenes as the Office Manager’s best partner, with one goal: maximize production and collections so our teams can focus on patients.



About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-driven insurance and billing specialist to join our ROC team. You’ll make sure every patient has verified coverage before they walk in, every visit is billed right the first time, every payment lands in the right place, and every ortho account stays accurate from banding to retention. You’ll work across PPO and Denti-Cal (Medi-Cal Dental), for both general dentistry and orthodontics.



What You’ll Own



Eligibility and benefit breakdowns



Verify Denti-Cal and PPO eligibility for scheduled patients ahead of their visits, and flag anyone without active coverage

Build accurate PPO benefit breakdowns in Open Dental (maximums, deductibles, frequencies, waiting periods, coverage percentages, and ortho benefits such as lifetime maximums, age limits, and payment frequency)

Prepare routing slips 2 days ahead so insurance details match the schedule, and check the schedule throughout the day for newly added appointments

Keep patient insurance information clean and current (subscriber details, plan updates, coordination of benefits)

Alert the office and call center to inactive, terminated, or changed coverage so patients can be contacted before their visit



Payment posting and account accuracy



Post PPO and Denti-Cal insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs) quickly and accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Post 
 payments and keep payment records clean

Upload and attach eligibility and supporting documentation to the correct patient charts and claims



Orthodontic billing



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims for PPO patients (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention)

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Learn our Denti-Cal ortho process over time (we’ll train you)



Claims follow-up and audits



Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with carriers and submit appeals when needed

Audit claims and balances proactively so errors are caught early, not “fixed later”

Double-check Denti-Cal and PPO policies to prevent denials and appeals

Keep clear notes in Open Dental, close every loop with the offices, and escalate chart, billing, or documentation issues quickly and clearly



What Good Looks Like (our READY standard)



Routing Slips Prepared: Every patient’s eligibility is verified before they arrive, and routing slips match the schedule so the office can execute immediately.

Ensure Schedule & Record Accuracy: Extreme attention to detail. Insurance and billing information is entered correctly and readable for the office.

Audit & Bill Daily: Breakdowns are accurate, claims are correct, balances make sense, and errors are caught early.

Dedicated to the Office: Strong ownership mindset. You keep a running task list, close loops with confirmation, and take work off the manager’s plate.

Yield Maximum Production: Fewer eligibility surprises, fewer denials, fewer billing mistakes, and no production left on the table.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental insurance experience, including eligibility verification, benefit breakdowns, and payment posting (PPO required)

US orthodontic billing experience and a strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Comfortable with payer portals and phone verifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work ahead of the schedule and manage high daily volume without sacrificing accuracy

Proactive and dependable in a remote setting: you close loops and confirm your work

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power and internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours



Nice to Have



Denti-Cal/Medi-Cal experience (strong plus)

Open Dental experience

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms such as 

A dental nerd at heart who wants to understand not just the “what” but the “why” behind our policies



Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume

A short summary of your dental insurance and ortho billing experience (practices, software used, typical daily volume)

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

Duvvy (

, chat and social DMs.

title: Product designer (UX/UI), mobile and web
description:
The League · Remote · Full Time



The League runs door-to-door sales teams that sell fiber internet for providers like Kinetic, Verizon, Ting and Astound. We build our own software. Reps use it to log sales, track their rank and earn incentives. Corporate staff use it to match those sales against provider reports and run payroll.



Engineers built most of the screens with off-the-shelf components, and it shows. The three apps don't look or behave like one product, and some workflows take more taps and clicks than they should. We want a designer to fix that.



What you'll design for



The rep mobile app (iOS and Android). Reps use it in the field, often in sun and on bad signal. They submit sales, capture customer consent, check the leaderboard, follow incentive campaigns, and message support. It's built with Expo and React Native using Nativewind and React Native Reusables.



The web dashboard. Reps, managers and corporate staff use it for sales and install tracking, leaderboards and monthly KPIs, prospects and onboarding, territory maps and blitz scheduling, teams, incentives, payroll and support. It's a Next.js app built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind.



The ingestion and review dashboard. Corporate staff use it to load provider reports, match reported orders to the sales reps submitted, and review the ones that don't match. Pay depends on getting this right. It's dense, table-heavy work, built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Recharts.



What you'll do



Audit the three apps and find where they disagree on navigation, terminology, components and visual style.

Build one design system that covers mobile and web: tokens, type scale, components and states. Base it on The League brand guide we already have.

Redesign the highest-traffic flows first. These include submitting a sale on mobile, the leaderboards, and reviewing unmatched orders.

Design for dense data: tables, filters, status, empty states, errors and loading.

Talk to reps and corporate staff, watch them use the apps, and bring what you learn into the designs.

Hand off Figma files that engineers can build from directly, and review the result in the running app.



What we're looking for



A portfolio that shows shipped work on both a mobile app and a data-heavy web dashboard or internal tool.

You've built or maintained a design system that engineers used.

You know iOS and Android conventions and can design for one codebase that runs on both.

Strong accessibility habits, including contrast, touch targets and readable dense tables.

You're comfortable working in Figma with a small engineering team that ships every week.



Nice to have



Experience with shadcn/ui, Tailwind or Nativewind, so your components map to what we build with.

A background in sales tools, field-worker apps, or payroll and finance back-office software.

Motion design for mobile.

title: Online Business Manager (OBM)/Project Manager
description:
The Role

The Online Business Manager/Project Manager (OBM) for Fancy Scientist is responsible for supporting the CEO, Stephanie Manka, in executing the vision of the Fancy Scientist LLC with clarity, structure, efficiency, and calm.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership.

The OBM works closely with the CEO and support team to manage projects end-to-end, maintain operational integrity, and ensure that launches, programs, and internal systems run smoothly without relying on the CEO to mentally hold everything together.



Most importantly, this role is NOT just administrative support. The OBM owns outcomes, protects founder energy, and ensures that work being delivered is aligned to the brand, tested, and ready meeting standards of excellence before it goes live.



The position will start out part-time and is expected to become full-time. 



This role can be broken down into four core areas:

Executive

Growth

Operations

Fulfillment



1. EXECUTIVE

The OBM supports leadership execution and cross-team coordination.

Responsibilities include:

Partnering with the the CEO to execute strategic priorities

Identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements

Maintaining alignment between leadership decisions and execution

Coordinating communication between team members and contractors

Overseeing and supporting a healthy, functional, and cohesive leadership team

Managing special projects and cross-functional initiatives



The OBM helps ensure that leadership decisions actually get implemented clearly, calmly, and on time.



2. GROWTH

The OBM supports launch execution and growth initiatives without being responsible for copy or creative.

Responsibilities include:

Supporting launches, promotions, and live webinars maximizing efficiency and conversions

Translating launch strategy into execution-ready project boards

Coordinating timelines across internal team members and external agencies

Ensuring launch assets move through clear create → review → test phases

Monitoring dependencies and flagging risks before they become fires



The OBM helps create calm, repeatable, and effective launch executions.



3. OPERATIONS

The OBM is a systems thinker who thrives on structure, clarity, and clean workflows.

Responsibilities include:

Creating and maintaining project boards and processes

Setting up and organizing project management software, Google Drive, and internal documentation such as SOPs

Managing onboarding workflows for members, clients, and contractors

Tracking KPIs and operational metrics



The OBM builds systems that allow the business to grow without burning people out.



4. FULFILLMENT

The OBM acts as the final quality check before anything goes live.

Responsibilities include:

End-to-end testing of launches, funnels, and workflows

Verifying registration,
, tagging, checkout, and replay flows

Ensuring pages, links, and assets are accurate and on brand

Acting as the last line of defense before launches or updates go live

Upholding brand quality and integrity across all deliverables (not necessarily limited to launches, e.g. social media, podcasts)

Ensuring the customer experience from onboarding to offboarding is clear, engaging, and scalable



If something is live, it should work and reflect the high standards of the Fancy Scientist brand.



THE DAY-TO-DAY

This role may include, but is not limited to:

Creating and managing project boards

Translating launch plans into clear execution timelines (we have detailed processes to reference - so part of the OBM role will ensure they’re optimized and followed)

Coordinating tasks across VAs and contractors

QA testing funnels, webinars,
s, and checkouts

Organizing assets, documentation, and internal resources

Assisting the CEO, as needed, to minimize bottlenecks in work flow

Improve overall workflows to reduce CEO involvement



CORE OUTCOMES THE OBM IS RESPONSIBLE FOR

Clear, execution-ready launch plans

Calm, confident execution

Team alignment, management, and communication

Founder energy protected

Creating repeatable systems for future launches and programs



THIS POSITION IS FOR SOMEONE WHO

Is resourceful, self-sufficient, and proactive

Takes full ownership and pride in their work

Is obsessed with organization, checklists, and clean systems

Communicates clearly and confidently (and isn’t afraid to speak up)

Spots problems and proposes solutions

Thrives in fast-moving environments with multiple priorities

Adapts quickly as strategy evolves

Is technologically savvy and systems-oriented

Can receive direct feedback without defensiveness

Values quality, integrity, and follow-through

Has high standards of excellence; can spot mistakes and shortcomings

Understands that calm execution is a competitive advantage

Is personally aligned with and values the mission of the organization



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Project management experience

Online launches and webinar-based funnels experience

Familiarity with James Wedmore / Business by Design style launches (we follow his launch and business management processes so you will have access to those)

Familiarity with online softwares such as Podia, Demio, Gsuite, Google Drive, Canva, Descript

WHAT WE DO

Fancy Scientist (1) Helps aspiring wildlife, conservation, and environmental sciences professionals plan their career path and get jobs so that they can carry out their mission of helping animals while getting paid for it, and (2) Creates inspiring wildlife and conservation content to get people excited about connecting to and protecting nature. 

We show that you don’t have to “look like a scientist” and aim to break stereotypes on the kinds of people who work in wildlife. We believe wildlife work is for anyone who wants it and show what is possible through our own and students’ successes. 



MEET OUR CEO

Dr. Stephanie Manka (formerly Schuttler) is a wildlife biologist with 17 years of research experience and 6 years of professional career mentoring in the wildlife, conservation, and environmental sciences space. 



Through Fancy Scientist, Stephanie has helped launch the careers of hundreds of struggling wildlife job seekers through directly securing jobs, internships, and graduate assistantships, showing them how to discover and unfold the career path right for them, gain experience, network with professionals, write job applications that get interviews, and more. Stephanie has spent her career studying wildlife, spreading messages of conservation, and helping others break into the field. She’s on a mission to build a new generation of professionals who are empowered, effective, and ready to make a real difference.

title: Senior B2B Cold Calling Superstar – Lead Generation
description:
Are you a natural sales hunter who loves cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and booking appointments? We want YOU!



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Australia Time



QPC Group is an award-winning Australian office technology company, established in 2008.



We're looking for an experienced B2B cold-calling specialist who knows how to turn complete strangers into genuine sales opportunities.



This is a pure outbound lead generation role. Your job is to find opportunities and book qualified appointments — our Australian sales team handles the selling and closing.



What You'll Be Doing



Cold calling Australian businesses using supplied prospect lists and our existing database.



Researching companies, finding decision-makers and confidently getting past gatekeepers.



Building rapport, asking great questions and uncovering business pain points.



Handling objections and turning conversations into qualified sales appointments.



Following up with prospects and keeping accurate CRM records.



Your calling activity will consist of approximately:



60% Cold Calling – Prospecting businesses and generating new opportunities.



30% Warm Database – Reconnecting with existing contacts and identifying opportunities.



10% Supplied Leads – Following up on leads provided by QPC Group.



We provide prospect lists, but you must know how to research businesses, identify the right contacts and reach decision-makers.



Who We're Looking For



You MUST have:



5+ years of proven B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Excellent spoken English and a natural, confident telephone manner.



Proven ability to get past gatekeepers, handle objections and reach decision-makers.



Strong prospecting and LinkedIn research skills.



A track record of consistently achieving appointment targets.



We're looking for someone persistent, resilient, self-motivated and genuinely passionate about hunting for new business.



No robotic script readers! We want someone who can have real conversations, build rapport and think on their feet.



Experience in IT, telecommunications, printers, photocopiers or other B2B technology solutions is a bonus.



What Success Looks Like



Our target is a minimum of 30 qualified sales appointments per month.



You must be comfortable with high-volume outbound calling, sometimes making 100+ calls per day.



However, we value quality over quantity. A day with 40 calls and several meaningful conversations can be more productive than 100 unanswered calls.



We measure success by genuine opportunities and qualified appointments, not just how many numbers you dial.



Working Hours



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia Time



You must have a quiet working environment, reliable internet and backup arrangements for power or internet outages.



How to Apply – Please Read Carefully!



Minimum Apply Points: 3



You must use at least 3 Apply Points when submitting your application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Mandatory Subject Line: Outbound Sales Genius



Please include ALL of the following:



Your CV – Highlight your B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Your Sales Results – Tell us your average calls per day, qualified appointments booked per month and targets achieved.



Voice Recording (Mandatory) – Send us a 30-second recording of your best cold-call opening to an Australian business owner about their office printers or photocopiers. We want to hear your confidence, personality and natural conversational skills. Please don't just read a script!



Your DISC Profile (Mandatory) – Include a copy of your DISC personality assessment results.



Working Hours – Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia time.



Please provide three genuine professional references.



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Contacting QPC Group outside this platform will disqualify your application.



Ready to Join Us?



If you're a proven sales hunter who loves the challenge of cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and turning a "not interested" into a qualified appointment, we'd love to hear from you!



We're looking for someone who doesn't just make calls — they make things happen!

title: Data Engineer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Data Engineer builds and runs the pipelines that feed Ally's data platform, so the rest of the company can trust and use its data. You'll join a new, growing Data Operations team, reporting to the Director of Data Operations and supporting teams across the business that depend on data from our CRM, TMS and product systems.

The role works primarily in Databricks, owning ingestion, transformations, pipeline monitoring and reliability. You'll be expected to move quickly while keeping strong engineering habits: version control, code review, testing and documentation. Clear written English and comfort working async with a US-based team are essential, with meaningful daily overlap with US business hours.



WORKING STYLE & EXPECTATIONS

●Operates with a high degree of independence, managing your own priorities within the direction set by the Director.

●Takes ownership of problems and fixes them before users notice.

●Treats monitoring, testing and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought.

●Uses AI-assisted development tools to work faster without sacrificing quality.

●Explains technical issues and tradeoffs in plain language for non-technical stakeholders.



TYPICAL DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW

This role follows an established workflow designed to keep the data platform reliable as it grows:

●Work is captured and prioritized as issues in Linear.

●All code lives in Git: branches, pull requests and code review before anything reaches production.

●New tables follow the team's medallion layering and naming standards.

●Every production pipeline ships with monitoring, quality checks and a runbook.

●Completed work closes the loop in Linear so stakeholders know what changed.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ingestion & Integration

●Build and maintain ingestion from internal systems (CRM, TMS and product databases) and external vendor and public data feeds.

●Replace fragile or manual data pulls with scheduled, monitored jobs.

Pipelines & Modeling

●Build transformations from raw data into clean, documented tables.

●Follow the team's medallion layering, naming and code review standards.

●Tune slow queries and inefficient data stores.

Reliability & Monitoring

●Monitor pipelines and resolve failures before they reach users.

●Add data quality checks and flags, so users know which tables they can trust.

●Keep runbooks current, so any team member can operate a pipeline.

●Track compute cost and right-size jobs and clusters.

Support

●Deliver clean, documented data to analysts and business teams for reporting and analysis.

●Pick up backlog items as the Director prioritizes them.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

●Strong SQL and Python, including PySpark or Spark SQL.

●Production experience building and operating batch pipelines on a lakehouse or cloud warehouse.

●Data modeling for analytics: dimensional or medallion-style layers.

●Git-based workflow: branches, pull requests, code review.

●Habit of monitoring, testing and documenting what you build.

●Clear written English and comfort working async with a US team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

●Databricks experience: Unity Catalog, Jobs, Delta Lake, Lakeflow or DLT.

●Ingesting from Salesforce, MongoDB, Postgres or REST APIs.

●AWS basics (S3, IAM, Lambda).

●Experience with AI-assisted or agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar).

●Experience in logistics, freight or another operations-heavy industry.



SUCCESS MEASURES

●Pipeline reliability: scheduled jobs succeed on time, and failures are caught and fixed before users report them.

●Data quality: key tables pass automated checks, and other tables carry accurate quality flags.

●Throughput: backlog items delivered at a steady pace with little rework.

●Operability: every pipeline has a runbook and can be run by someone else.

●Cost: compute spend tracked and trending down per job as jobs are tuned.

title: Executive and Administrative Coordinator
description:
About Us

Utopia helps our founders launch and manage consumer brands that make everyday life better. We serve mainstream online consumers across the United States with products that deliver trusted quality, value for money, and memorable branding, backed by our commitment to 100% customer satisfaction.



Our 10-year target is to launch and manage a portfolio of brands generating $100 million in revenue. Achieving that vision takes smart decisions, reliable systems, and consistent execution.



Our core values guide how we work and what we expect from every team member:

- Early Adopter: We keep a pulse on smarter ways to work.

- Data Driven: We let facts guide decisions and measure what matters.

- Customer Obsessed: We put clients first and focus relentlessly on their success.

- Detail Oriented: We deliver with precision, consistency, and care.



Position Summary

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive & Administrative Coordinator to support Utopia’s leadership team and the daily coordination required to launch, manage, and grow consumer brands.



This role keeps calendars organized, communications moving, meetings productive, travel coordinated, documentation accurate, and onboarding activities on track. As a central point of contact for administrative matters, the coordinator helps information reach the right people and ensures commitments are tracked through completion.



The ideal candidate anticipates needs, manages competing priorities, handles confidential information with discretion, and takes pride in helping others do their best work. They are comfortable learning new technology, using data to track progress, and improving recurring processes as the business grows.



Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Productivity, Calendar & Inbox Management

- Manage and optimize calendars for the GM and Founders, scheduling meetings, coordinating availability, and resolving conflicts.

- Monitor designated inboxes, organize communications, flag priorities, and track responses and follow-ups.

- Coordinate meeting invitations, agendas, reminders, and supporting materials.

- Anticipate upcoming deadlines and outstanding commitments, helping leaders protect time for their highest priorities.

- Exercise sound judgment when prioritizing requests and escalating matters that require leadership attention.



2. Travel Research & Coordination

- Research and coordinate travel for trade shows, retailer meetings, client visits, vendor meetings, and other business activities.

- Compare options for cost, timing, and convenience, and arrange flights, accommodations, and ground transportation within approved budgets.

- Prepare accurate itineraries with reservations, schedules, meeting details, and relevant contacts.

- Coordinate event and meeting logistics, including registrations and required materials.

- Track travel expenses and maintain records for expense reporting and reimbursement.

- Communicate itinerary changes promptly and resolve travel issues as they arise.



3. Meeting Preparation, Executive Briefings & Follow-Through

- Prepare agendas, presentations, briefing documents, and supporting materials.

- Attend meetings and document key decisions and action items, including clear owners and deadlines.

- Distribute meeting notes and follow up on outstanding commitments.

- Maintain organized, accessible records of meeting materials and decisions.

- Keep action trackers current and flag overdue items or blockers before they affect other work.

- Use approved AI tools and meeting technology to improve note-taking, summarization, and documentation.

- Executive Communications & Cross-Team Coordination

- Serve as a central coordination resource for the executive team and internal stakeholders.

- Draft professional
s, announcements, meeting recaps, and routine business communications.

- Coordinate information requests between executives, account teams, clients, vendors, and external partners.

- Track open requests and follow through to ensure timely responses and completion.

- Help manage executive communication priorities so important matters are handled without unnecessary interruptions.

- Maintain contact information, distribution lists, and relevant business records.

- Exercise sound judgment regarding when to act independently and when executive input or approval is required.



4. Administrative Operations, Vendor & Documentation Management

- Coordinate the preparation, collection, approval routing, signing, and filing of agreements, forms, and administrative documents.

- Maintain accurate records of vendor information, contracts, renewal dates, and important deadlines.

- Track pending approvals, signatures, and outstanding paperwork.

- Work with internal stakeholders and external partners to collect missing information and keep documents moving through established processes.

- Handle sensitive business, financial, client, and personnel information with confidentiality and discretion.

- Assist with expense reports, invoices, purchasing requests, and other administrative finance processes within defined approval limits.



5. Employee & Client Onboarding Coordination

- Coordinate new-hire paperwork, orientation schedules, system access, and required resources with the appropriate team members.

- Ensure new employees receive the information, tools, and introductions they need to get started.

- Coordinate onboarding for new clients and brands, including documentation, kickoff meetings, shared resources, and outstanding requirements.

- Maintain onboarding checklists with clear responsibilities and deadlines.

- Follow up on incomplete steps and help deliver an organized, responsive experience from the first interaction.



6. Cross-Team Coordination & Operational Support

- Serve as a coordination point among the GM, Founders, brand teams, clients, vendors, and external partners.

- Communicate updates, requests, deadlines, and reminders clearly and professionally.

- Track tasks and administrative deliverables that support brand launches and ongoing operations.

- Keep shared trackers accurate so teams can see progress, priorities, and outstanding commitments.

- Identify coordination gaps and administrative bottlenecks, and help resolve them.

- Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.



7. Process Improvement & General Administrative Support

- Create and maintain checklists, templates, trackers, and standard operating procedures for recurring work.

- Keep contact lists, shared files, calendars, and administrative records accurate and easy to navigate.

- Evaluate and use digital tools, AI, and automation to reduce repetitive work, following company policies and checking outputs for accuracy.

- Use practical measures, such as completion times, overdue tasks, and errors, to identify and assess process improvements.

- Research solutions and complete administrative tasks independently whenever possible.

- Communicate blockers early, recommend next steps, and follow assigned work through completion.

- Research, Special Projects & Operational Support

- Conduct research, gather information, compare alternatives, and summarize findings to support executive decision-making.

- Assist with the coordination of assigned internal projects and operational initiatives.

- Organize project timelines, owners, administrative deliverables, and next steps.

- Track completion of assigned tasks and proactively communicate progress, blockers, and deadlines.

- Prepare simple reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and information summaries as needed.

- Take ownership of projects within the role's scope, working independently and involving executives only when necessary.

- Support other business priorities that improve executive effectiveness and organizational efficiency.



Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications

- 2–4 years of experience in executive assistance, administrative coordination, operations support, or a similar role.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Consistent attention to detail when managing schedules, records, documents, and follow-ups.

- Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, take ownership, and work independently.

- Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.

- Resourcefulness and adaptability when plans or priorities change.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, including
, calendars, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.

- Comfort maintaining task trackers and using basic data to monitor progress and support decisions.

- Curiosity about new tools and a willingness to learn better ways of working.

- A service-oriented approach to supporting leaders, colleagues, clients, and external partners.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience directly supporting a General Manager, senior executive, or multiple department leaders.

- Experience in consumer brands, e-commerce, brand management, or a business supporting multiple clients or brands.

- Experience coordinating domestic and international business travel, trade shows, client visits, or corporate events.

- Familiarity with electronic signatures, document management, contract tracking, and expense management tools.

- Experience coordinating employee, client, or brand onboarding.

- Familiarity with project management tools, workflow automation, and AI-assisted administrative work.

- Experience working with remote or distributed teams.

- A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience is welcome.



What Success Looks Like

- Leadership stays focused: Calendars reflect priorities, inboxes are organized, and important matters receive timely attention.

- Commitments become completed work: Meeting decisions and action items have clear owners and deadlines, with blockers escalated early.

- Details are dependable: Travel, documentation, records, and meeting materials are accurate, complete, and easy to access.

- Onboarding builds confidence: New employees, clients, and brand partners experience a smooth, responsive start.

- Teams stay coordinated: Requests and deliverables are visible, handoffs are clear, and follow-ups happen without repeated prompting.

- Processes improve as we grow: Better documentation and appropriate technology reduce administrative delays, errors, and repetitive work.

- Core values show up in daily work: You explore smarter tools, use facts to prioritize, respond to client needs, and deliver with precision and care.



Why Join Us

- Help build consumer brands: Contribute to a portfolio focused on trusted quality, value for money, and memorable branding.

- Support an ambitious vision: Help create the systems and coordination behind our $100 million revenue target.

- Take ownership: Make a visible contribution to how effectively the organization operates.

- Put innovation into practice: Explore better tools and workflows, and help turn useful ideas into everyday improvements.

- Broaden your experience: Gain exposure to executive operations, brand launches, client relationships, and projects across teams.

- Work with clear values: Join a team that values initiative, facts, founder success, and careful execution.



Reporting Structure

- Reports to: General Manager or designated operations leader.

- Works closely with: Founders, brand teams, clients, vendors, and external partners.

title: Senior Marketing Coordinator (Social Media)
description:
Senior Marketing Coordinator (Social Media) | College Graduate with A+ English Writing Skills Required



U.S.-based law firm seeks a sharp, analytical, and proactive Senior Marketing Coordinator to own the firm's social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and 
. This is not a scheduling job. You will plan the content, write it, publish it, reply to every comment and message, and then go out and engage: commenting on and joining the conversations happening on our referral partners' and prospects' posts every single workday. You will track the numbers, tell us what they mean, and change what isn't working.



The firm is virtual and works with developers, investors, lenders, commercial real estate brokers and residential real estate agents. You will work closely with our graphic designer, giving the creative direction for the graphics on your posts, and you will report directly to the firm's Managing Attorney. The ideal candidate is a college graduate with excellent English, a head for analytics, and experience marketing a professional services firm, preferably in law, real estate or finance.



RESPONSIBILITIES: The Senior Marketing Coordinator will have the following responsibilities:



• Publish content across LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and 
, scheduling through HubSpot's social media tool, and manage the firm's connected social accounts in HubSpot

• Reply to every comment and message on the firm's accounts the same business day, and route potential client inquiries to the firm's intake team

• Engage proactively every workday: leave thoughtful, substantive comments on posts from referral partners, clients, prospects and industry organizations so the firm becomes a familiar voice in those conversations

• Own the social media content calendar and bring a steady stream of original content ideas tied to real estate market news, firm milestones and the questions our audience is asking

• Write all social media captions and post copy in the firm's voice and to its style guide

• Give our graphic designer clear creative direction on every graphic (concept, on-image text, format and due date), review drafts for brand fit, and keep production on schedule

• Track performance across every platform and in HubSpot, and keep a weekly scorecard in Excel covering reach, engagement rate, follower growth, outbound engagement and inquiries

• Deliver a monthly analytics report that explains what worked, what didn't, and what you will change next month

• Draft suggested posts and comments for the Managing Attorney's personal LinkedIn profile

• Make sure every post is professional, on brand, and approved by an attorney before it goes live



REQUIREMENTS: The following skills and characteristics are required:

• Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English, Business or a related field. Latin honors, Dean's List, or a degree from a leading university strongly preferred

• Excellent English writing and speaking skills. Your writing should sound like a thoughtful professional, not a template

• 3+ years managing social media for a business, including at least 1 year for a U.S. or other foreign client

• Experience marketing a law firm or other professional services firm (legal, real estate, finance or insurance) strongly preferred

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable with LinkedIn Page analytics, Meta Business Suite and TikTok analytics, calculating engagement rates, and building reports and charts in Microsoft Excel. We work in Microsoft 365 and do not use Google Sheets

• Experience with HubSpot's social media tool or a similar scheduler (Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Later). A HubSpot Academy social media certification is a plus

• A proven habit of proactive engagement, with examples of how you grew a brand's reach through comments and conversations, not just posting

• Working knowledge of Canva, enough to mock up a concept and give a designer clear direction and feedback

• Self-directed and reliable: you meet deadlines and send reports without being reminded

• Excellent judgment and attention to detail, and the discipline to follow brand and compliance guidelines in a regulated industry

• Tech savvy and eager to use AI to work smarter, while editing anything AI-assisted into your own voice

• Portfolio required: social media accounts you have managed, sample posts, and at least one analytics report you created (with confidential data removed)



COMPENSATION: $8 to $12 USD per hour, based on education, experience and the results of a paid skills test. Rate review at 90 days.



BENEFITS: 10 paid holidays per year, and the firm will pay a 13th month bonus (equal to the average of one month's pay).



HOURS PER WEEK: The Senior Marketing Coordinator will be expected to initially work 30 hours per week (6 hours per day), Monday through Friday, anytime between the hours of 9:00am and 6:00pm Eastern Time (U.S.), so you can engage with our audience while they are online. The role may grow for the right candidate.



ADDITIONAL DETAILS: This job requires a high-speed, secure internet connection and a backup power or internet source. You are expected to work from your own home.



HOW TO APPLY: Read these instructions carefully. How you follow them is part of how we evaluate you.

1. Use this subject line: Senior Social Media | [Your Full Name] | [Your University]

2. Send your resume/CV, a short cover letter, links to your portfolio, and your hourly pay requirement in USD.

3. In your cover letter, answer both of these questions:

a. A commercial real estate broker posts on LinkedIn that they just closed the sale of a 40,000-square-foot retail center. Write the comment you would leave from our law firm's page.

b. In three to five sentences, how would you tell whether a law firm's social media is producing new business and not just likes?

4. If you have taken the IQ, English or DISC tests linked on OnlineJobs.ph, include your scores.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Please use at least 7 Apply Points when applying.



Hihintayin namin ang application mo. Galingan mo, kaya mo yan!

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.

Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.

title: On-Camera Video Presenter – YouTube Channel Intros (Work From Home, Flexible Schedule)

We are a growing YouTube media company that manages multiple channels across different niches — health, lifestyle, finance, travel, and more. We are looking for a young, energetic, camera-confident presenter (preferred age 18–30) to record short intro and hook segments for our YouTube videos.



You present. We handle everything else. Our team writes the scripts, provides direction, and does all the editing. Your only job is to show up on camera, read the script with energy and personality, and deliver a clean take.

$300/month

Monthly retainer option available for the right person once we establish a working rhythm

Paid promptly per batch via Wise, or bank transfer — your choice

Read pre-written scripts with energy, warmth, and a natural, conversational delivery

Film yourself in HD from home using your smartphone or webcam

Batch-record multiple intros in a single session for efficiency (most presenters do 5–10 in one sitting)

Follow light direction from the team on tone, pacing, and energy for different channel styles

✅ What We Are Looking For



Required:



Preferred age 18–30 — we are looking for a youthful, fresh on-screen presence

Previous on-camera experience — YouTube, TikTok, vlogging, hosting, acting, or student media

title: Senior Performance Media Buyer
description:
Senior Performance Media Buyer | 8-Figure DTC E-Commerce Brand



Company: APE BORN Fitness

Location: Remote (at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time)

Employment: Full-time contract

Hours: 40+ hours per week, plus availability for urgent account issues and major sales events

Pay: Based on experience, plus performance-based bonuses



ABOUT THE ROLE

APE BORN Fitness is a fast-growing eight-figure DTC e-commerce brand. We're looking for an experienced Senior Performance Media Buyer to help scale our paid acquisition across Meta, Snapchat, AppLovin and other emerging channels.



This is a hands-on execution and growth role. We don't want someone who only launches campaigns, adjusts budgets and reports ROAS. We want someone who understands that a media buyer's job is to scale the business by finding and removing the bottlenecks that stop profitable growth.



You'll work directly with our growth, creative and CRO teams to find winning ads, scale campaigns, improve acquisition efficiency and build new strategies that unlock growth. You must be comfortable managing large ad budgets, making decisions on your own, and saying clearly what needs to happen next.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



1. Profitable media buying and scaling

- Manage and scale campaigns across Meta, Snapchat, AppLovin and other channels as needed.

- Scale budgets up and down daily based on profitability and acquisition targets.

- Monitor new-customer ROAS, contribution margin, spend and performance against targets.

- Find ways to increase spend without losing acquisition efficiency.

- Build and test new campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences and scaling methods.

- Manage international campaigns and spot opportunities to expand into new countries.



2. Creative performance and testing

- Analyze creative performance daily to find winning hooks, angles, formats and offers.

- Share winning creatives and clear recommendations with the creative team.

- Spot underperforming creatives and recommend improvements.

- Build new testing plans from performance data and market observations.

- Keep creative performance boards up to date and make sure winners are documented.

- Coordinate rolling out winning creatives across ad platforms.

- Work with creative strategists to keep developing new ad approaches.



3. Finding growth bottlenecks

- Find the biggest bottlenecks stopping the business from scaling.

- Prioritize by expected impact, urgency and speed to implement.

- Investigate issues across ads, conversion rates, offers and customer acquisition.

- Recommend solutions backed by performance data.

- Work with the right departments to fix what you find.



4. Working across teams

- Work closely with the creative team on ad performance and testing speed.

- Work with CRO on product pages, landing pages and checkout.

- Share useful insights with
/SMS, sales, customer service and finance.

- Join weekly growth discussions with clear recommendations.



5. Campaign operations and account health

- Launch scheduled campaigns across ad platforms.

- Keep campaign naming, creative organization and reporting accurate.

- Monitor account health, tracking, disapprovals and platform restrictions.

- Fix or escalate account issues quickly while staying within platform rules.

- Monitor performance on weekends, during promotions and high-volume sales periods when needed.



REQUIRED

- Proven experience scaling DTC e-commerce ad accounts.

- Personally scaled at least one Meta account to $10,000+ in daily spend while hitting acquisition targets.

- Personally managed at least $1M USD in total Meta ad spend.

- Scaled daily ad spend by 3x or more.

- Strong understanding of creative-led advertising and performance analysis.

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads Manager and AppLovin.

- Able to analyze new-customer CAC, contribution margin, conversion rates and other business metrics.

- Strong written communication and teamwork.

- Able to manage campaigns, set priorities and make decisions on your own.

- Full-time with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.



NICE TO HAVE

- Personally managed $10M+ in total ad spend.

- Scaled a single account beyond $50,000 in daily spend.

- Experience advertising health, fitness or wellness products.

- Experience scaling across multiple countries.

- Experience with Triple Whale, Shopify, 
 and Google Sheets.

- Managed large budgets during Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

- Worked directly with creative strategists and CRO teams.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: learn our ad setup, targets and creative testing system; run daily ad operations and launches on your own; present our biggest growth bottlenecks with a prioritized plan; set up steady reporting and creative feedback.

First 60 days: improve campaign efficiency and find new ways to scale; run structured creative testing and scaling; help fix high-impact bottlenecks; find and scale winning creatives faster.

First 90 days: show measurable progress toward scaling profitable daily spend; build a repeatable system for finding and expanding winners; bring growth ideas beyond the ad platforms; work independently while keeping leadership informed.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're analytical, proactive and commercially minded. You know profitable scaling isn't just adjusting budgets: it's finding what's blocking growth and working with the right people to fix it. You don't wait to be told what to test or scale. You take ownership and communicate clearly. Most of all, you think like a business operator, not just a media buyer.



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please answer these briefly:

1. Have you personally scaled a Meta ad account to $10,000+ in daily spend while hitting acquisition targets? (Yes/No, plus the brand type and peak daily spend)

2. Have you personally managed at least $1M USD in total Meta ad spend? (Yes/No, plus your rough total)

3. Can you work full-time with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time? Which hours?

4. Your expected monthly pay.

We are seeking a technical and process-driven CRM Operations Specialist to serve as the operational backbone of our sales and marketing efforts. 1. System Administration & Data Architecture

4. Analytics, Reporting & Enablement

Build custom HubSpot and Shopify-connected dashboards to track key operational metrics: wholesale pipeline health, average order value (AOV), customer re-order rates, and deal velocity.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Senior IT Engineer



Prevent problems before they happen. Automate what shouldn’t be done twice. Do great work with great clients — and earn the autonomy to do it your way.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to close tickets faster. You’re here to make sure the same problem doesn’t come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.



We’re looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You’ll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You’ll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best engineers we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: “How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a problem is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s fully resolved, documented, and won’t come back

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I fix this faster?” they ask “why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?”

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to



Who Thrives Here



People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we’ve also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren’t in conflict here.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that’s not a problem — it’s the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn’t just to solve the problem in front of you — it’s to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.



That looks like:



Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms

Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become i

Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely

Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery

Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes

Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent

Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust

Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you’ve seen enough environments to know what good looks like

Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don’t need to look up the basics

Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack

Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it

PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems

Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them

VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating

Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix

Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients’ environments.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve taken full ownership of your client environments

Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them

You know where the gaps are and you’ve already started closing them



At 6 months:



Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster

Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first



At 12 months:



Clients notice the quality difference

The “this issue again?” 
nts have dropped significantly

Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you

You’ve shaped how we operate — and the business is investing in your next step



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next

You fix the symptom and move on without asking why

You treat documentation as someone else’s responsibility

You’re comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment
