description:
# Full-Time Remote Operations Coordinator  

### Philippines-Based | Long-Term | Growth Opportunity



**Site Masters Junk Removal** is a fast-growing Tampa Bay junk removal and property cleanup company. We are hiring a long-term **Remote Operations Coordinator** to help keep our customers, technicians, trucks, schedules, estimates, invoices, and job documentation organized.



This is not a basic data-entry role. You will help operate the remote control tower of a growing field-service business.



We value people who are organized, proactive, calm under pressure, honest, and willing to take ownership.



## Main Responsibilities



### Operations and Scheduling



- Build and update daily technician routes.

- Confirm job addresses, timing, crew assignments, and special instructions.

- Communicate route information to technicians.

- Monitor delays, schedule changes, callouts, and vehicle issues.

- Coordinate with the field operations manager regarding truck, equipment, and safety issues.

- Keep Jobber and internal records accurate.

- Track open issues until they have an owner and next action.



### Customer Communication



- Answer customer messages and provide professional updates.

- Communicate ETAs, delays, reschedules, and missing information.

- Request photos for remote estimates.

- Follow up with customers when details are incomplete.

- Document customer conversations and commitments.

- Escalate complaints, property damage, payment issues, and unusual requests.



### Estimates, Invoices, and Follow-Up



- Prepare draft estimates using approved pricing procedures.

- Prepare and send invoices.

- Follow up on open quotes and unpaid invoices.

- Request deposits or payments when required.

- Review job details before customer-facing documents are sent.

- Escalate pricing questions or unusual discounts for approval.

- Call technicians to communicate timelines and changes and ensure on-time delivery (you will be using the phone in this role)



### Job Documentation and Quality Control



- Review before-and-after photos.

- Organize customer photo albums and Google Drive folders.

- Request missing or unclear job documentation.

- Confirm notes, photos, payments, and invoices are completed.

- Track incomplete jobs until they are properly closed.



### Phone Support



You may also answer company phone lines as backup support. Depending on your experience and performance, phone responsibilities may become a larger part of the role.



Phone responsibilities may include:



- Answering inbound customer calls.

- Qualifying leads.

- Booking appointments.

- Gathering job details and photos.

- Handling basic pricing questions using approved guidelines.

- Documenting calls accurately.

- Escalating sales, safety, and customer-service issues.



## Requirements



- Previous virtual assistant experience is required.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work Monday through Saturday, approximately **8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time**.

- Minimum typing speed of **50 WPM**.

- Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs and software systems.

- **At least 8GB RAM, SSD storage, and a second monitor available from the start.**

- Reliable primary internet connection.

- Backup internet or mobile data.

- Quiet workspace and reliable headset for phone support.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Comfortable learning software quickly.

- Able to stay calm while handling multiple urgent issues.

- Willing to receive direct feedback and improve.



Experience with Jobber, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, CRMs, dispatch, customer service, logistics, or home-service businesses is preferred.



## Compensation



- **$1,200 to $1,500 USD per month to start**, depending on experience and performance.

- Paid trial period.

- Compensation can increase as you demonstrate independent ownership, accuracy, phone ability, and reduced need for supervision.

- Strong performers can grow into senior operations or team-lead responsibility.



This is a long-term opportunity. We are building a serious remote operations team, not looking for someone to complete random short-term tasks.



## Core Values



### Unshakable Integrity



Tell the truth, communicate early, follow through, and own mistakes.



### Extreme Ownership



Do not simply forward problems. Identify the next action, assign ownership, and follow up until the issue is resolved.



### Relentlessly Driven



Learn quickly, improve constantly, and perform at a high level without needing to be chased.



### Calm Under Pressure



Operations create problems every day. We solve them clearly, professionally, and without spreading confusion.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your résumé.

2. A short introduction explaining your VA experience.

3. Your current typing speed.

4. Your computer specifications.

5. Confirmation that you have a second monitor.

6. Your internet and backup-internet setup.

7. Your available working hours in Eastern Time.

8. Your expected monthly compensation.

9. The word **Precision** in the subject line or first line of your application.



Qualified applicants will receive a separate screening application and next-step instructions.



All application communication will happen through OnlineJobs.ph messaging or
. Please do not call the company’s customer phone line regarding this position.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the moment a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Bring order - VA - Operations and SOPs builder
description:
JOB TITLE: Bring order - VA - Operations and SOPs builder



Some people walk into a messy room and feel tired. Others start sorting before they've put their bag down. This job is for the second kind.



If you do your best work with a clear routine and clear instructions, that's a real strength, and this is the wrong job for it. If this is you, you will quickly feel lost and overwhelmed, and you will struggle to add value.





AT A GLANCE

What: look after our clients, and bring order to a growing business

Who: a sharp self-starter who already uses AI every day

Where: remote, small team (founder in the UK, technical VA and video editor in the Philippines)

Hours: full-time and flexible, with a big overlap with UK working hours, especially in the beginning

Pay: PHP 30,000–40,000 a month, plus bonuses when a launch succeeds

When: apply by Wednesday 18 November, 23:59 Philippine time

How: two steps, at the bottom of this page





WHAT YOU'LL DO (in order of priority)

1 — Clients first. Stay on top of the inbox every day. Every client and lead gets a prompt, proper answer, and orders, questions and follow-ups never slip. This is the heart of the role.

2 — Bring order. Tidy the Drive, rebuild the task and project boards, and write the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as you go.

3 — Keep things moving. Track what was agreed and chase everyone — me included. Upload and schedule videos. When you see a simpler way to run something, set it up.





WHERE YOU'LL WORK

I run three connected UK health projects: IrisLab (iridology equipment), HealthDataLab (a longevity platform for practitioners) and Altituding (health and longevity coaching). One mission: helping people stay healthy and capable for longer.



I'm a creative founder: I build products, film content and start things. Quim, my technical VA of three years, builds with me.



Every new project goes through a messy middle: more ideas than systems, more things started than finished. It's a normal phase, and we're in it. On day one you'll find:

- Client
s that have waited longer than they should

- A Google Drive with duplicates, old versions and no naming rules

- A Notion task board that is months out of date

- Videos filmed but not yet uploaded

- No SOPs, no daily task list, no routine yet. You build all three.



If that list makes you curious rather than nervous, keep reading.





WHO YOU ARE

- You've worked with a creative founder before, or started something of your own: a shop, a channel, a community group, a side project. You know what early-stage looks like, and you liked it.

- You write clear, warm English. Clients will hear from you directly.

- You're sharp. You work things out, research what you don't know, and ask a good question when you're stuck.

- We use AI a lot, and you already work this way every day. No need to be an expert — just not new to it, and not resistant to it.

- You're organised in your own life. Your process lives in a system, not in your head.

- You d
 and act, then tell me what you did.

- You can handle a curve ball and smile.



Not for you if you keep side clients or side-hustles, or go quiet when the work gets intense. Mistakes are fine here — they get fixed by talking. Disappearing isn't an option.





WHAT YOU GET

- PHP 30,000–40,000 a month, depending on what you bring

- Bonuses on top when a launch succeeds

- 13th month, Philippine holidays plus your birthday off, paid via Wise

- The steps: short form → one-take video and a short task → video call → paid test task → paid trial week → paid trial month





HOW AND WHEN TO APPLY (both steps, or I won't read it)

1 — Apply here on OnlineJobs using 8 apply points (your OnlineJobs application credits). Subject line: "Bring Order — [your name]". No need to write me a message here.

2 — Fill in the short application form (about 5 minutes): 

Put any messages or questions for me in the form.



Closes Sat 14 November, 23:59 Philippine time.



I love fruit, by the way: in the last box of the form, tell me your favourite local fruit and what it costs where you live.



Evidence, not adjectives. The word "passionate" is banned.

title: Assistant Bookkeeper
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Assistant Bookkeeper to manage day-to-day accounting and financial records for a U.S.-based small business with 1–5 employees. This position will work under the guidance and supervision of an experienced, Philippines-based accounting team lead.



Key Responsibilities

Maintain accurate bookkeeping records using QuickBooks Online.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions.

Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and contractor payments.

Collect, organize, and maintain receipts, invoices, statements, and other supporting financial documents, ensuring they are properly filed and easily accessible.

Coordinate employee payroll using Gusto.

Prepare monthly financial reports, including Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet.

Prepare year-end books and financial records for the company's CPA and tax filings.

Identify discrepancies and ensure accurate, timely financial reporting.

Work closely with the accounting team lead to maintain accurate and organized financial records.

Follow established accounting procedures, internal controls, and reporting requirements.

title: Supply Chain Manager (Shopify/E-commerce)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain & E-commerce Operations Specialist to join our growing e-commerce team.



This is a hands-on operational role. You will be responsible for monitoring orders from purchase through delivery, identifying fulfillment issues before they become bigger problems, coordinating with suppliers and Customer Support, and making sure our Shopify backend and operational data remain accurate.



We are specifically looking for someone who already has experience working with Shopify and e-commerce operations and understands how orders, fulfillment, refunds, subscriptions, tracking and suppliers work together.



Your daily responsibilities will include:

- Monitoring Shopify orders and fulfillment statuses

- Identifying aging, delayed and problematic orders

- Monitoring open orders and shipment exceptions

- Tracking shipments through tools such as Parcel Panel, 17TRACK and carrier websites

- Investigating failed deliveries, returned-to-sender shipments, missed pickups and address issues

- Coordinating with suppliers and fulfillment partners to resolve order issues

- Monitoring supplier-raised concerns and following up until resolved

- Reviewing and validating refunds and cancelled orders

- Checking that refunds, cancellations and fulfillment statuses are correctly reflected in Shopify

- Monitoring subscription-related order issues

- Coordinating with Customer Support on cancellations, refunds, subscriptions and delivery problems

- Reviewing COGS and validating costs against Shopify orders

- Identifying incorrect quantities, costs or order information

- Reviewing chargebacks and disputes against existing orders

- Maintaining internal supply chain trackers and keeping case statuses accurate

- Preparing and exporting shipment/order data when required

- Proactively identifying operational problems instead of waiting for customers to complain

- Escalating unresolved issues to the appropriate team member, supplier or fulfillment partner



What we're looking for:

- Previous experience in e-commerce operations, supply chain, fulfillment or order management

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify

- Experience handling a high volume of e-commerce orders

- Understanding of order fulfillment from purchase to final delivery

- Experience working with suppliers, warehouses or 3PL/fulfillment partners

- Experience with shipment tracking and delivery exceptions

- Understanding of refunds, cancellations, chargebacks and subscriptions

- Strong attention to detail

- Good spreadsheet skills

- Strong written English

- Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

- Ability to follow SOPs while using common sense when something does not look right

- Strong ownership mentality and reliable follow-up

- Experience with Parcel Panel, 17TRACK, subscription platforms, PayPal disputes or similar tools is a strong plus.



What success looks like:

We don't want someone who simply checks tasks off a list.



A strong person in this role notices when an order has been stuck for too long, catches mismatched costs or statuses, follows up with suppliers without being reminded, makes sure refunds and cancellations are actually completed, and keeps Customer Support informed when action is required.



You should be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of an issue until it is resolved.



To apply



Please send us:

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your previous e-commerce or supply chain experience

- How long you have worked with Shopify

- Which fulfillment, tracking and subscription tools you have used

- An example of an operational or fulfillment problem you identified and solved

- Your current availability

- Your expected monthly salary



Please start your application with the word “SHOPIFY” so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Instagram Reels Editor & Creative Strategist
description:
About the Role:



•⁠  ⁠We’re looking for a creative video editor to help edit short travel content 
 so they perform as effectively as possible on social media.



•⁠  ⁠The page focuses on short cinematic travel, bucket-list destinations, adventure, and real moments with Alfonso exploring the world. We don't require heavy special effects, complex software, or fancy motion graphics. CapCut or any tool you prefer is more than enough for the style of content we create. 



What Matters Most



•⁠  ⁠As seen 
 IG, the editing is not technically complex. The focus is on choosing the strongest clips, placing them in the most effective order, using text where needed to support the story and retention, and creating a cinematic flow that keeps people watching.



What You'll Be Doing



•⁠  ⁠Editing & Pacing: Turning raw travel footage into viral high-retention Reels (around 6 to 25 seconds long).

•⁠  ⁠Finding the Hook: Figuring out the best way to open each video so people stop scrolling.

•⁠  ⁠Working Together: Teaming up with us on feedback, alternative versions, and tweaking things based on what performs well.



Pay Structure



•⁠  ⁠$100/month Base Retainer: This guarantees a steady base to cover trial experimentation, testing hooks, exploring ideas, revisions, and creative back-and-forth communication.

•⁠  ⁠Trial vs. Main Posts: During experimentation, you will test and pitch trial edits. When a trial is polished and approved to go live as a main post 
 it turns into a payable item!

•⁠  ⁠+$20 per Reel published on the main page (we usually expect 1 to 3 posted per week).

•⁠  ⁠+$20 bonus for any single Reel that hits 1,000+ new followers within 90 days. (Bonuses apply while we're actively working together).

•⁠  ⁠Everything is tallied up and paid out monthly.



Volume & Expectations



•⁠  ⁠Minimum: 1 published Reel per week

•⁠  ⁠Normal range: 1–3 published Reels per week

•⁠  ⁠More can be published when strong ideas are working

•⁠  ⁠Output may be lower at the beginning while we learn what works best together



What We Look For



•⁠  ⁠A good eye for cinematic flow, beautiful travel shots, and visual storytelling.

•⁠  ⁠Solid grasp of short-form social media (knowing how to pace a video so it doesn't get boring).

•⁠  ⁠Someone who actually watches social media trends and understands why certain videos grab attention.

•⁠  ⁠A willingness to test ideas and learn as we go.



How to Apply



To make sure you're a great fit for this role, please include the following in your application:

•⁠  ⁠Link to your portfolio with your best travel, lifestyle, or cinematic Reels (experience with travel and cinematic editing is preferred).

•⁠  ⁠Briefly walk us through your process once you receive raw content, how do you usually organize, tackle a project, and collaborate on feedback?

•⁠  ⁠Pick one 
 existing Instagram Reels, and in 3-4 sentences, pitch an alternative hook and a quick concept breakdown for how you would have edited it differently to capture attention faster.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Are you the type of salesperson who loves closing deals, hates leaving money on the table, and knows how to turn a “let me think about it” into a booked job? We want you on our team!



JT is looking for a driven, confident, and highly organized Inside Sales Representative who knows how to sell over the phone. We're not looking for someone who simply answers inquiries and sends quotes. We need someone who takes ownership of every lead, follows up consistently, handles objections, and turns potential customers into paying customers.



If you enjoy talking to people, chasing opportunities, hitting targets, and seeing your hard work translate into results, this could be the perfect role for you.



What You'll Be Doing

Close sales over the phone. Turn inbound inquiries into booked jobs by building rapport, asking the right questions, presenting solutions, and confidently asking for the sale.

Move fast on new leads. Contact new inquiries within 5 minutes whenever possible. Speed matters, and we don't want good leads going cold.

Follow up like a pro. Call, text, and reconnect with customers who haven't booked yet. One call is rarely enough, and you'll know when to keep the conversation going.

Turn estimates into sales. Follow up on open quotes, address concerns, overcome price objections, and help customers make a decision.

Manage a busy pipeline. Keep track of new leads, callbacks, text conversations, pending estimates, and scheduled jobs without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Keep the CRM updated. Record accurate notes, track every conversation, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.

Coordinate with the team. Help customers with scheduling, answer questions, and ensure a smooth experience from the first call to the booked job.

Hit your numbers. Work toward daily sales goals, strong conversion rates, and consistent performance.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a salesperson first, not just a customer service representative.



You might be a great fit if you:

Have 2–5+ years of experience in inside sales, telesales, appointment setting, or phone-based sales.

Are comfortable spending most of your workday making and receiving calls.

Know how to handle objections, discuss pricing, and confidently ask customers to buy.

Don't give up after one unanswered call or one “not right now.”

Can manage multiple conversations and tasks without losing track of important details.

Are comfortable using CRMs, phone systems, text messaging platforms, and scheduling tools.

Communicate in clear, natural, professional English.

Take ownership of your results and don't need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

Are competitive, coachable, organized, and motivated by hitting targets.

Can take feedback, participate in call reviews, and work on improving your sales skills.

Experience in home services is a plus, but it's not required. If you've sold HVAC services, roofing, plumbing, cleaning services, insurance, automotive services, memberships, or other consumer services over the phone, we'd love to hear from you.



We can teach you our services and systems. What we can't teach as easily is the drive to pick up the phone, follow up, and close the deal.



What Success Looks Like

We want someone who takes every lead seriously and understands that every missed follow-up could mean a missed sale.



Here are the results we're working toward:



New leads contacted in under 5 minutes whenever possible.

A target booking/close rate of 50% or higher.

Consistent follow-up on every open estimate and sales opportunity.

A meaningful contribution toward JT's daily sales goal of $20,000+.

Accurate CRM records and a pipeline where no lead gets forgotten.

These are performance targets, not guarantees. Your ability to consistently execute, learn, and improve will matter.



What This Job Is NOT

Let's be clear about a few things.



This is not a passive customer service role where you answer questions and wait for the next call.

This is not a job where you send a quote and hope the customer gets back to you.

This is not a fit for someone who dislikes making outbound calls or following up multiple times.

This is not a role for someone who needs constant supervision to stay productive.

Some customers will say no. Some won't answer. Some will push back on price. That's part of sales. We need someone who stays professional, keeps moving, and knows how to create opportunities instead of waiting for them.



Why Join JT?

Work remotely from home.

Be part of a team that values initiative, accountability, and results.

Develop your phone sales, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Have clear performance goals so you know what success looks like.

Get the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's growth.

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas, messaging angles, campaign concepts, and copy that differentiates gigCMO in the market.

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services and translate strategic marketing, fractional CMO, growth consultancy, and capability-building concepts into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

The Talent Coordinator will support the agency’s daily operations, primarily focusing on brand outreach, pitching, follow-ups, campaign coordination, and administrative organization.



You will work collaboratively with our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ, and report to the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are looking for someone who can manage assigned responsibilities independently, communicate effectively with international brands, and maintain consistent productivity throughout their scheduled working hours.



This position requires someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every individual task.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Outreach & Partnership Pitching



* Research and identify brands that align with our creators’ niches, audiences, aesthetics, and interests.

* Pitch creators to beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fashion, clothing, accessories, footwear, lifestyle, and other relevant brands.

* Prepare and send professional, personalized brand outreach
s.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitches, responses, and potential opportunities.

* Identify opportunities for paid collaborations, events, PR campaigns, gifting, and other relevant partnerships.

2.
 & Inbox Management



* Organize creator-specific
 accounts.

* Maintain appropriate
 labels and folders.

* Categorize brand responses, partnership inquiries, affiliate opportunities, invoices, contracts, and campaign correspondence.

* Monitor incoming
s and promptly identify important brand responses.

* Keep inboxes organized and ensure no important partnership opportunities are overlooked.

* Maintain monthly pitching and outreach organization.



3. Campaign & Partnership Coordination



* Track ongoing brand campaigns and partnership deadlines.

* Assist with campaign scheduling and creator calendars.

* Monitor deliverables, posting deadlines, campaign requirements, and follow-up obligations.

* Request campaign briefs, budgets, timelines, and licensing information from brands when necessary.

* Communicate important campaign updates to the Founder & Head of Talent.

4. Contract Review & Administrative Support



* Review draft campaign agreements and identify unusual or unfavorable terms.

* Prepare suggested edits and redlines based on agency instructions.

* Flag concerns involving usage rights, licensing, exclusivity, paid advertising, whitelisting, Spark Ads, raw footage, deliverables, and payment terms.

* Organize signed agreements and relevant campaign documentation.

All final deal approvals and creator representation decisions remain with the Founder & Head of Talent.



5. Team Coordination



* Work directly with the existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.

* Coordinate assigned responsibilities and avoid duplicating outreach.

* Communicate progress, outstanding assignments, and important updates.

* Participate in internal coordination and follow established agency procedures.

* Maintain organized handovers when assignments require collaboration.



Daily Work Schedule & Expectations



The required schedule is:



Monday through Friday



* Start: 1:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* End: 9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* Weekly schedule: 40 hours.



Applicants must be able to consistently work according to New York’s Eastern Time, including daylight-saving-time changes.



This is not a flexible-hours position. Applicants must be available during the specified schedule.



Coordinators are expected to complete their assigned daily responsibilities, maintain accurate records, and communicate any outstanding work before the end of their shift.



Assignments must not simply be abandoned or left without an update when the scheduled shift ends. If an urgent task requires additional time, the coordinator must communicate with management and obtain approval for any additional working hours. Any additional work and compensation will be handled in accordance with the agreed arrangement and applicable law.



Performance Expectations & Pitching Standards



We value quality, consistency, and actual results over simply sending large quantities of
s.



Our general outreach planning range is approximately 100–150 targeted opportunities per assigned creator per month, depending on the roster, workload, creator preferences, and available opportunities.



The maximum general planning limit is 200 opportunities per creator per month unless otherwise approved.



We expect:



* Professional and personalized outreach.

* Accurate spelling, grammar, and creator information.

* Appropriate brand and creator matching.

* Consistent follow-ups.

* Proper tracking of outreach.

* Timely responses to brand inquiries.

* Initiative in identifying new partnership opportunities.

* No fabricated analytics, rates, or creator information.



AI Policy



We do not permit AI-generated or AI-assisted brand pitching or outreach.



Every pitch must be individually written, thoughtfully personalized, and reviewed by the coordinator before sending. We want genuine human communication, not generic automated messages.



Compensation & Commission Structure



Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD



The final monthly rate will depend on qualifications, relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated performance, and overall suitability for the position.



Compensation is performance-oriented.



We expect coordinators to consistently complete their responsibilities and demonstrate meaningful contributions to the agency’s pitching and partnership efforts.



Performance reviews may consider:



* Quality and quantity of targeted pitches.

* Successful brand responses and conversions.

* Paid partnerships directly generated through the coordinator’s outreach.

* Consistency of follow-ups.

* Organization and reliability.

* Overall contribution to creator growth and agency operations.

title: Amazon FBA Lead Researcher - US Private-Label Brands (Verified Emails)a
description:
WHAT WE DO

We remove Amazon reviews that violate Amazon's Community Guidelines. Our clients are US private-label brands with large review bases and rating problems. We only get paid when a review is actually removed.



WHAT I NEED

An experienced lead generation specialist who builds a list where every single row is verified.

Not a list of "Amazon sellers". A list I can hand to sales without redoing the work.

Long-term role. Part time or full time, both work.



FIELDS PER LEAD

1. Brand name

2. Amazon US storefront URL

3. Hero ASIN (best-selling) + link

4. Hero ASIN: total review count

5. Hero ASIN: current star rating

6. Hero ASIN: number of WRITTEN 1-star, 2-star and 3-star reviews

7. Hero ASIN: Best Sellers Rank + main category

8. Number of active ASINs in the storefront

9. Product category and average price

10. Company website

11. Decision maker: full name

12. Decision maker: job title

13. Decision maker: work
, verified as deliverable

14. Verification tool used + result status

15. Decision maker LinkedIn URL

16. LinkedIn active in last 90 days: YES / NO (posted or commented)

17. One sentence: why this brand fits



IMPORTANT - RATINGS ARE NOT REVIEWS

The star histogram on a listing shows percentages of RATINGS. Most of those are star-only ratings with no text. We cannot work with those - we need reviews that contain text.

Field 6 therefore means WRITTEN reviews only. You get the real number from the filtered view of the listing (filter by 1 star, then 2 stars, then 3 stars), where Amazon shows "X total ratings, Y with reviews". Y is the number we need. Never calculate it from the percentages.



HARD FILTERS - a row is rejected if any of these fails

- Listing is not on 

- Not private label: no Brand Store, or the brand does not sell its own listing, or it is a reseller / wholesaler / dropshipper

- Hero ASIN under 500 total reviews

- Under 100 WRITTEN reviews in the 1-3 star range

- Rating above 4.4 or below 3.5

- Under 5 active ASINs in the storefront

-
 not verified as deliverable

- Generic inbox only 
 
 
 

- Decision maker title is not one of: Founder, CEO, Owner, President, Head of Amazon, Amazon Manager, Marketplace Manager / Director, E-commerce Manager / Director, Brand Manager



LINKEDIN

Include the LinkedIn URL whenever one exists. Leads without LinkedIn are accepted. But at least 50% of every batch must be LinkedIn-active (posted or commented in the last 90 days). We run a separate LinkedIn channel and need those contacts.



HOW WE START

- Paid test batch: 25 leads, fixed price. I review every single row.

- 80%+ accepted: we continue on a fixed monthly rate.

- Target after the test:
accepted leads per week.



TOOLS

Your choice. Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerSprite, Apollo, Hunter, NeverBounce, Sales Navigator. Tell me what you use and whether you hold your own licences.



TO APPLY - answer these three. Applications without answers are ignored.

1. Send ONE example lead in the exact format above. A real US private-label brand, real data, one complete row.

2. How exactly do you determine the number of WRITTEN 1-3 star reviews on a listing? Describe the steps.

3. How do you verify a brand is private label and not a reseller?



Do not send a generic cover letter. The example row is your application.



PLEASE READ BEFORE YOU APPLY

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph only. Do NOT
 me personally and do not contact me on any other channel. I only reply to applications sent through this platform - everything else is ignored.

Your profile has to match this job. I am looking for an experienced lead generation person, not a beginner. Profiles without real lead generation and research experience will not get a reply.

 with this exact subject line:

title: HubSpot Full Implementation Expert
description:
This is a Full Time Project role and expected to be completed within 2 months.



We are looking for a hands-on HubSpot expert who can also manage the implementation project. You will help onboard our teams, structure our CRM, connect our lead sources and build practical workflows and automation across both markets.



This role requires direct experience implementing HubSpot—not just using it for contact entry or administrative support.



Your Main Objective



Build a reliable, easy-to-use HubSpot system that helps us capture enquiries, assign leads to the right salesperson, follow up consistently, track sales opportunities and measure results across Singapore and Malaysia.



Our intended lead journey includes:



Paid advertising → Shopify enquiry forms → HubSpot → Sales assignment → Follow-up and nurturing → Sales conversion → Reporting



Key Responsibilities



1. Implementation Planning and Project Management



Review our existing HubSpot setup, sales processes, lead sources and business requirements.



Develop an implementation roadmap with clear priorities, milestones, responsibilities and timelines.



Coordinate with management, marketing, e-commerce and sales teams across both countries.



Maintain a project tracker and provide weekly updates on progress, outstanding decisions and blockers.



Recommend practical solutions that work within our subscribed HubSpot plans and budget.



2. CRM Setup and Data Organisation



Configure HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, including relevant Professional-tier features available under our subscriptions.



Set up contact, company and deal properties, lifecycle stages, lead statuses, pipelines and ownership rules.



Organise records by country, business channel, product interest and customer type.



Clean, deduplicate and import existing data where required.



Configure appropriate user access and document clear data-entry standards.



3. Lead Capture and Integrations



Connect Shopify enquiry forms and relevant lead sources to HubSpot.



Ensure enquiries capture the information needed for sales follow-up and reporting.



Set up lead-source and campaign tracking where supported.



Configure lead routing by country, enquiry type, product category or assigned salesperson.



Assess native integrations first and identify any need for tools such as Zapier or Make, including associated costs.



4. Workflows and Automation



Build and test workflows for lead assignment, internal notifications and follow-up tasks.



Set up acknowledgement
s, nurturing journeys and re-engagement campaigns where appropriate.



Implement reminders and escalation rules for uncontacted leads and stalled opportunities.



Configure sales sequences where supported and appropriate to the team’s process.



Apply suitable consent checks, suppression rules and safeguards against duplicate or inappropriate messages.



5. Reporting and Visibility



Create dashboards showing lead volume, lead sources, assignment and follow-up activity, pipeline progress and sales conversion.



Provide separate Singapore and Malaysia reporting, alongside a consolidated management view.



Help management identify missed follow-ups, pipeline bottlenecks and opportunities to improve performance.



6. Testing, Training and Handover



Test the complete lead journey before launch, including routing, notifications, automation and reporting.



Resolve issues and support users during rollout.



Produce clear SOPs, workflow documentation and short video tutorials.



Train our teams to use and maintain the system confidently.



Provide ongoing optimisation and troubleshooting if the engagement is extended.



Required Experience and Skills



Proven hands-on experience implementing HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.



Experience building workflows, sales pipelines, lead-routing rules, dashboards and CRM data structures.



Ability to manage a project independently, from requirements gathering through setup, testing, training and handover.



Experience connecting websites or e-commerce platforms to HubSpot; Shopify experience is strongly preferred.



Strong understanding of lead management, sales follow-up and marketing automation.



Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly.



Strong attention to detail, proactive communication and reliable follow-through.



Reliable internet connection and availability for scheduled online meetings.



An Advantage



Relevant HubSpot certifications.



Experience supporting businesses with multiple countries, brands or sales channels.



Experience with both B2B sales and consumer e-commerce.



Familiarity with Meta and Google lead sources, Zapier, Make and integration troubleshooting.





Expected Deliverables



An approved implementation roadmap and project tracker.



A documented CRM structure and configured sales process.



Working lead capture, assignment and follow-up workflows.



Tested automation with clear documentation.



Sales and management dashboards.



Team training, SOPs and a complete handover.



We will agree on the delivery schedule after the initial review of our requirements and current setup.

## About My Wedding Media



My Wedding Media is a professional wedding photography and filmmaking company dedicated to creating cinematic, emotional, and timeless wedding films.



We believe every wedding tells a unique story, and our goal is to capture those moments through beautiful visuals, intentional storytelling, and exceptional editing.



We are seeking a **highly experienced, creative, and detail-oriented Wedding Film Editor** to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate has a strong background in wedding filmmaking, an exceptional artistic eye, and the ability to transform raw footage into emotionally compelling cinematic films.



You will work directly under our **Creative Director**, collaborating on multiple wedding film projects while maintaining our company's creative standards and visual identity.



## Key Responsibilities



- Edit cinematic wedding highlight films, full-length wedding films, trailers, and social media reels.

- Transform raw wedding footage into beautifully crafted, emotionally engaging stories.

- Collaborate directly with the Creative Director to execute creative concepts and maintain a consistent editing style.

- Select meaningful moments, dialogue, music, and visuals to create compelling narratives.

- Perform professional color correction, cinematic color grading, sound design, and audio mixing.

- Seamlessly incorporate vows, speeches, ceremony footage, and other important wedding moments.

- Maintain organized editing timelines, project files, and media assets.

- Manage multiple wedding projects simultaneously while meeting production deadlines.

- Implement creative feedback and revisions efficiently.

- Maintain a high standard of quality, creativity, and attention to detail across all projects.



## Required Qualifications



**Applicants must meet the following requirements:**



- **Minimum 5 years of professional film or video editing experience.**

- Proven experience editing cinematic wedding films.

- Advanced proficiency in **Adobe Premiere Pro**.

- Experience with Adobe After Effects, Audition, and other Adobe Creative Cloud applications is highly preferred.

- Must have their own professional computer, licensed editing software, and access to all necessary editing tools.

- Must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional wedding film editing skills.

- Excellent understanding of storytelling, cinematic composition, pacing, music selection, and emotional storytelling.

- Strong skills in color grading, sound design, audio mixing, and seamless transitions.

- Experience working with high-resolution footage, including 4K video.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work within established deadlines.

- Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and attention to detail.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work directly with the Creative Director.

- Ability to receive constructive feedback and implement revisions.

- Reliable internet connection for transferring large video files and collaborating remotely.



## Who We're Looking For



**We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to edit videos. We are looking for a true visual storyteller.**



Our ideal editor understands the emotions, beauty, and storytelling that make wedding films memorable.



You should have a natural eye for cinematic visuals, a strong sense of musicality, and the ability to recognize meaningful moments that bring a couple's story to life.



We value creativity, consistency, reliability, and a genuine passion for filmmaking.



The right candidate should be confident working independently while following creative direction and maintaining the signature style and quality of My Wedding Media.



## Projects You Will Work On



- Cinematic wedding highlight films

- Full-length wedding documentary films

- Wedding trailers and teasers

- Social media wedding reels

- Ceremony and reception edits

- Additional creative filmmaking projects



You must be comfortable managing **multiple projects simultaneously** without compromising quality or deadlines.



## Interview & Paid Editing Project



Selected applicants will be invited to participate in our interview and evaluation process.



**Shortlisted candidates will be assigned a paid editing project** to demonstrate their technical abilities, creative storytelling, editing style, and ability to follow direction.



We will evaluate:



- Cinematic storytelling and creative vision

- Editing quality and attention to detail

- Music selection and emotional pacing

- Color grading and sound design

- Ability to follow creative direction

- Communication and project turnaround time



Candidates selected to complete the editing project will be compensated for their work.



## Compensation & Opportunity



Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio quality, project complexity, and editing capabilities.



We are looking for a dependable editor interested in building a **long-term professional relationship** with My Wedding Media as our company continues to grow.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send your application directly to:







*
 Subject: Wedding Film Editor Application – [Your Name]**



Your
 must include:



1. **Introduction:** A brief introduction about yourself and your professional editing background.

2. **Portfolio:** A link to your professional portfolio showcasing your wedding film editing skills.

3. **Recent Work:** At least three examples of recent wedding films you personally edited.

4. **Adobe Experience:** A brief description of your experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and other editing tools.

5. **Availability:** Your current availability and ability to take on multiple projects.

6. **Editing Rates:** Your expected rate per wedding highlight film and full-length wedding film.



**IMPORTANT: Applications without a professional portfolio and recent wedding film samples will not be considered.**



We are excited to connect with talented editors who share our passion for cinematic filmmaking, meaningful storytelling, and exceptional creative work.



**My Wedding Media**  

*Capturing Love. Creating Timeless Films.*

Prior experience driving e-commerce sales or retail lead generation (furniture, lifestyle, or consumer hardware experience is a plus).



High proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel/CAPI, and SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar tools).



Strong understanding of short-form ad frameworks (hooks, call-to-actions, visual storytelling) on Meta and TikTok platforms.

Certifications in Google Ads or Meta Certified Media Buying are highly advantageous.



Analytical mindset with strong data interpretation skills and budget control.

NewClear Computing is a small Australian IT company looking for one helpdesk technician based in Cebu. You'll support our business clients with day-to-day IT issues, and we'll train you toward Microsoft 365 administration, including Azure, Copilot and AI tools, and give you an introduction to cybersecurity practices.



This is a full-time role, working from home in Cebu, using a secure company Windows desktop. Hours follow the Australian workday, so it's a daytime shift in Cebu, not a night shift.



What you'll do

- Handle helpdesk requests: Windows 11, Microsoft 365,
, Teams, printers and day-to-day IT issues

- Talk with clients clearly and professionally

- Help with user accounts, licences and basic Microsoft 365 admin as you learn

- Follow security practices, get an introduction to cybersecurity, and help with tools such as endpoint protection

- Document what you do and escalate when you need to

- Use AI tools we provide (you'll have your own account) to work faster and learn as you go



What we're looking for

- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable with Windows 11 and everyday Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, OneDrive)

- Genuine interest in learning Microsoft 365 admin and cybersecurity, not only closing tickets

- Reliable, organised, and happy to ask questions and follow a process

- Based in Cebu and available full time



Nice to have, not required

- Any experience with Microsoft 365 admin centres, SharePoint or Entra ID

- Azure, Copilot, PowerShell, or cybersecurity interest or training

- Prior helpdesk or IT support experience



Pay and training

₱25,000 to ₱35,000 a month, depending on experience. If you already have some Microsoft 365 tenant experience, we'll be at the higher end of that range. We'll train you toward becoming a Microsoft 365 admin, with a path into Azure, Copilot and AI-assisted support, and an introduction to cybersecurity practices.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. Your CV

2. A short note about your helpdesk or Microsoft 365 experience, and why you want to grow into a 365 admin role

3. A 1 to 2 minute video of yourself (phone is fine) introducing yourself in English, showing a bit of your experience, and why you're interested in this role



You can submit the video as a link (Google Drive, OneDrive or unlisted YouTube) or as an attachment.

title: Video Editor (Direct Response, Dutch Ads) – $1,500/month
description:
What we offer



$1,500 per month, paid monthly. Tools are provided, including Higgsfield.

A steady, long-term role with new briefs every week.

Room to grow. As our ad spend scales, so does this role: more volume, higher pay, and the chance to grow into a lead editor or creative strategist role.



About us



I run Snoraura, a sleep brand. Our main product is Lunara, a silent vibrating wrist alarm that wakes you up without waking your partner. We sell in the Netherlands and Belgium and advertise on Meta, testing new video creatives every week. I’m looking for an editor I can hand a brief to and get a finished ad back without a lot of back and forth.



What I’m looking for



CapCut expert. That’s where we work, in shared projects, and I need you to be fast and precise in it.

Hands-on Higgsfield experience. A growing part of our supporting footage is generated there rather than filmed.

ChatGPT in your workflow for subtitles or quick variations is a plus.

Comfortable with Dutch. Our ads are in Dutch. You don’t need to be a native speaker, but you must be comfortable working with Dutch scripts and voiceovers, and placing Dutch subtitles accurately. Native Dutch or Flemish speakers are a strong plus.

Direct response, not brand film. The first three seconds d
 whether an ad works. Think of the moment someone’s alarm goes off and their partner wakes up, or the relief of waking up quietly. If you’ve only edited weddings, showreels or corporate videos, this isn’t the right fit.



How we work



You never have to invent the concept. Every job comes as a written brief with the hook, the angle, the shot order, and the footage or references attached.

You build what’s in the brief, and you ask your questions before you start, not after the second revision.

First cut within 24 hours of receiving the brief.

title: Beyond Intelligence is building Alexander, an AI virtual receptionist for plumbing companies across the United States.
description:
Remote | Part-Time | ₱15,000–₱30,000/month Earning Potential | Growth to ₱80,000/month



Join an AI Company at the Beginning of Something Big



Artificial intelligence is transforming how businesses operate. At Beyond Intelligence, we're building technology that helps everyday businesses compete, grow, and operate more intelligently.



Our newest product, Alexander, is an AI-powered virtual receptionist designed for home-service companies across the United States.



Alexander helps businesses answer incoming calls, capture potential customers, and book appointments—even when their teams are busy, unavailable, or working in the field.



We're initially targeting industries such as plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, landscaping, cleaning, pest control, and other home services.



Now we're looking for an exceptional appointment setter who wants more than just another remote job.



We're building our outbound sales team from the ground up, and you have the opportunity to become one of its earliest members.



You'll work directly with our founding team, introduce American business owners to valuable AI technology, and help shape how we acquire customers.



This is not a generic virtual assistant position. It's an opportunity to develop your sales career inside an ambitious technology company, where your performance can directly influence your compensation, responsibilities, and future growth.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company—not simply collect a paycheck.



What You'll Do



Make outbound calls to home-service businesses throughout the United States.



Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers.



Introduce Alexander and explain how it can help them capture more business.



Ask thoughtful questions to understand their challenges and identify genuine opportunities.



Handle objections confidently, naturally, and professionally.



Schedule qualified product demonstrations.



Send personalized follow-up
s to interested prospects.



Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, and appointments in our CRM.



Share insights and feedback to help us continuously improve our sales strategy.



You'll receive the tools, leads, training, and support needed to succeed. Your primary responsibility is to create qualified sales opportunities through excellent communication and consistent execution.



Who We're Looking For



We're especially interested in candidates who have:



Previous experience in cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or outbound B2B sales.



Clear, fluent, natural English and confidence speaking with American business owners.



A warm, persuasive, professional communication style.



Excellent listening skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.



Confidence handling objections and rejection.



Strong written communication skills.



Consistency, reliability, organization, and self-discipline.



A willingness to learn, accept coaching, and improve continuously.



Genuine ambition to grow professionally and financially.



Experience selling SaaS, software, marketing services, telecommunications, or home services is an advantage, but not required.



We value attitude, communication ability, coachability, and demonstrated performance more than impressive résumés.



Compensation: Your Performance Creates Your Opportunity



PART-TIME — ₱15,000–₱30,000/month earning potential



You'll begin with approximately 20 hours per week.



Your compensation includes:



₱15,000 guaranteed monthly base compensation



₱500 for every qualified appointment you generate that the prospect attends



₱1,500 for every new customer you source who makes their first monthly payment



Your total earnings increase as you generate more qualified opportunities and paying customers.



The ₱30,000 monthly figure represents performance-based earning potential, not guaranteed compensation.



FULL-TIME GROWTH OPPORTUNITY — ₱30,000–₱80,000/month earning potential



As our sales operation expands, successful team members may be offered full-time positions with:



Guaranteed base compensation of ₱30,000–₱50,000/month, depending on performance, responsibilities, and business needs



Additional appointment-setting and customer acquisition commissions



Opportunities to earn higher commission rates



Potential advancement into senior sales, team leadership, training, or sales management responsibilities



The ₱80,000 monthly figure represents potential total earnings for exceptional performance, not a guaranteed salary or promotion.



Our philosophy is simple: when you create meaningful value for the company, we want you to share in the rewards.



Your Schedule



Part-time: 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday



Required working hours:



9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (Los Angeles)



This generally corresponds to:



12:00 midnight–4:00 a.m. Philippine Time during U.S. daylight saving time



1:00 a.m.–5:00 a.m. Philippine Time during U.S. standard time



You must be comfortable consistently working according to the U.S. Pacific Time schedule.



What We Provide



Comprehensive product and sales training



Prospect lists and lead-generation resources



Professional calling and CRM tools



Sales scripts, objection-handling guidance, and proven outreach frameworks



Ongoing coaching and performance feedback



Direct communication with the founding team



A supportive environment where good ideas are welcomed



The opportunity to help build a sales organization from its earliest stages



A clear path to greater responsibility and earning potential through demonstrated results



Why This Opportunity Is Different



Most sales jobs place you inside an established system where your responsibilities are already defined and your opportunities for advancement may be limited.



At Beyond Intelligence, we're still building that system.



That means your ideas, feedback, and results can have a real impact on how our company grows.



As we expand into additional home-service industries and acquire more customers, we intend to create opportunities for the people who helped make that growth possible.



The person who joins us today as an appointment setter could eventually become a senior sales representative, team leader, or an important contributor to our larger sales organization.



Those opportunities aren't automatic. They'll be earned through performance, initiative, reliability, and leadership.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants to make calls. We're looking for someone who wants to help build something meaningful—and become more successful in the process.



How to Apply



If you're confident speaking with American business owners, enjoy the challenge of sales, and want to build your career in the AI industry, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply through our official application form:







The application includes questions about your experience, availability, communication skills, a mock cold-call exercise, and a written follow-up exercise.



You may use generative AI to assist with the written exercise, but your final response must sound natural, personal, and professional.



Applications submitted through other channels may not be reviewed.



Requirements: Reliable internet, a quiet professional workspace, and the ability to consistently work the required U.S. Pacific Time schedule.



The AI revolution is creating an entirely new generation of companies and career opportunities.



At Beyond Intelligence, we're working to become one of those companies.



If you have the communication skills, discipline, ambition, and determination to grow alongside us, we'd love for you to be part of what we're building.



Apply today. Your next career opportunity could be much bigger than your next job.
