description:
Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern | Fluent English required



About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.



Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.



The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.



You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.



The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:

- 80% Recruiting & Talent AcquisitionYour primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.

- 20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business SupportWe're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.



Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.



We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.



What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.



Day to day, that means you:

- Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.

- Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.

- Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

- Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.

- Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.

- Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.

- Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.

- Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.



What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:

- Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

- Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

- Lifecycle Marketing:
 Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

- E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing ManagersSales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals



As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.



What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)



1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

- Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.

- Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.

- Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.

- Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.

- Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.

- Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.

- Conduct structured interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.

- Perform reference checks when appropriate.

- Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.

- Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.



2) Candidate Evaluation

- Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.

- Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.

- Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.

- Build structured interview scorecards for every role.

- Develop role-specific interview questions.

- Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.



3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

- Build and improve recruiting workflows.

- Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.

- Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.

- Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.

- Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.

- Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.



4) Partnership With Leadership

- Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.

- Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.

- Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.

- Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.

- Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.



5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

- Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.

- Write engaging candidate outreach messages.

- Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.

- Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.



6) Onboarding Support

- Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.

- Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.

- Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.

- Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.



7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional ProjectsWhen recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

- Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.

- Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.

- Helping coordinate marketing projects and follow-ups.

- Supporting special projects from marketing leadership or the Founder.

- Helping create or improve SOPs and internal processes.

- Supporting HR and administrative projects.

- Researching solutions to business or operational problems.

- Taking ownership of other projects where your skills can help the company move faster.



This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

- 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.

- Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 



Nice to have:

- LinkedIn Recruiter

- Indeed

- OnlineJobs.ph

- Google Workspace

- Asana

- AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Startup or e-commerce experience

- Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs



As a fully remote team, TopFoxx uses Time Doctor during working hours for international team members. Time Doctor is a time-tracking and productivity tool that records hours worked and takes periodic screenshots while the timer is running. For this full-time role, it is used to verify and track the expected 8-hour workday.

title: Admin & Bookkeeping VA | Exp in Aroflo, Trades
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on Aroflo experience, strong Xero skills and a background in Australian trades or construction admin will be prioritised for this role.



A fast-growing Australian plumbing and roofing business needs a part-time VA, initially 20 hours per week across Monday to Friday afternoons, to take ownership of the admin and bookkeeping workload that has built up alongside rapid growth. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role with a strong bookkeeping component. The right person will be confident in Xero and Australian bookkeeping fundamentals, with enough initiative to work autonomously during a business day when the owner is largely unreachable on-site.



A key part of the role is Aroflo, the business’s newly adopted job management platform, which replaces its previous job management and variation tracking tools. The owner is swamped and wants someone who can manage the platform on his behalf rather than someone he has to teach. Recorded training from Aroflo is available if your knowledge isn’t yet strong, but the expectation is that you take ownership of the system and become the go-to person for it.



The challenge being solved is straightforward: the owner is doing the financial and administrative work himself because there is no one else to do it, and it’s costing him the time and headspace he needs to win work and build the team. There is enough work to justify a full-time hire in the foreseeable future; the part-time start is about setting the right person up well before expanding their hours.



Success at 90 days looks like Aroflo running smoothly with you as the point person, daily reconciliation and invoicing running without the owner’s involvement, job-level cost tracking maintained consistently, outstanding invoices being chased, and payroll preparation happening on schedule. The owner should be opening his inbox to a clean summary, not a list of tasks still to do himself.



What You’ll Own



Aroflo Ownership & Systems Management



Take ownership of Aroflo as the owner’s day-to-day administrator, so he doesn’t need to work in the platform himself

Work through Aroflo’s recorded training (if needed) and become the in-house point person for how the system is used

Keep jobs, clients, quotes, scheduling and invoicing data accurate and up to date

Identify where the team’s use of Aroflo is inconsistent or incomplete, and flag or fix it

Document how Aroflo is used in the business through SOPs, so processes don’t depend on any one person



Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Reconcile Xero weekly and flag any unmatched transactions for review

Process and manage invoices: review, allocate, and confirm against jobs in Aroflo

Track and document approved variations to ensure all chargeable work is captured before a job closes

Follow up outstanding invoices as directed

Assist with payroll data preparation for review and submission

Support BAS and IAS data preparation each quarter, flagging key dates in advance

Process supplier payments as directed via WISE or an equivalent platform

Keep on top of outstanding bills and flag upcoming payment deadlines



Invoicing & Variation Tracking



Review completed jobs in Aroflo weekly and identify any un-invoiced or under-invoiced variations

Cross-check field reports against the scope of work and flag anything not yet charged

Prepare and send invoices through Aroflo, ensuring ABN, address, quantities and scope details are correct



Job-Level Cost Tracking & Reporting



Maintain job-level spreadsheets tracking cost versus income for each active job

Pull weekly data from Aroflo to update job profitability trackers

Identify jobs where costs are high relative to expected margins and flag for review

Compile a weekly job summary covering what has been invoiced, what’s in progress, and what’s outstanding

Track supplier invoices against jobs and ensure costs are allocated correctly



Inbox & Communication Management



Filter and manage the owner’s inbox daily: categorise, action, and forward invoices to Xero as required

Ensure no client follow-ups or leads go unanswered, flagging anything needing direct attention

Handle routine supplier communication: order confirmations and delivery queries

Send job confirmation, scheduling and follow-up messages to clients as directed



Scheduling & Task Management



Assist with managing the job calendar and scheduling in Aroflo as directed

Coordinate subcontractor and team scheduling when instructed

Set reminders for recurring tasks: invoicing runs, payroll deadlines, vehicle registrations, licence renewals and subscriptions

Maintain a running list of ideas and pending tasks so nothing falls through the cracks



SOP Documentation & Systems



Document processes as they’re learned, in real time rather than retrospectively

Maintain and update task records in Asana with daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Contribute to the business handbook as the role develops, creating a source of truth for each task



Daily Communication



Send a morning WhatsApp message with top priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything requiring attention or approval



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Experience in general admin and bookkeeping support in an Australian business context

Familiar with Australian bookkeeping basics: GST, invoicing, reconciliation, payroll, BAS/IAS

Hands-on Aroflo experience is highly desirable and would be a standout

Where Aroflo experience is limited, experience with comparable trade job management software and the ability to learn Aroflo quickly using the recorded training is essential

Prior experience with trades or construction businesses is a strong advantage

Comfortable working in a small, fast-growing business without formalised systems



Technical Proficiency



Aroflo: strong experience preferred, with recorded training available to supplement

Xero: required, with strong practical proficiency

Confident with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

Able to build and maintain job-level cost tracking spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets

Comfortable with WhatsApp, including voice notes, as the primary comms channel

Basic proficiency in Asana, or willing to learn



Organisational Skills



High attention to detail, particularly when reviewing invoices, variations and job costs

Able to manage a high-volume inbox and triage effectively without daily direction

Capable of maintaining multiple active job trackers simultaneously without losing accuracy

Proactive about setting reminders and following up on time-sensitive items



Communication Skills



Strong written and verbal English, as you will handle client and supplier communication directly

Brief, clear and to the point; phone calls are preferred for urgent matters, with voice notes and short WhatsApp messages for day-to-day

Comfortable batching questions into a single call rather than interrupting multiple times

Confident enough to follow up on outstanding information rather than waiting



Non-Negotiables



Works autonomously for extended periods without daily check-ins

Initiates tasks without being prompted and doesn’t wait for direction on repeatable processes

Fast learner on platforms, able to teach themselves through recorded training, SOPs and on-the-job experience

Treats the numbers as business-critical: understands that missed variations, untracked costs and late invoices have real dollar consequences

Raises flags early when something doesn’t look right, without going off on their own without the owner’s awareness

Naturally documents what they learn and builds processes that don’t rely on memory

Comfortable with ambiguity in a business that is still building its systems

Discreet and trustworthy with financial data, client information and business-level detail



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday afternoons (exact hours TBC at placement)

Genuine path to full-time once settled in and capability is proven

Primary point of contact is largely unreachable on-site during the day; a second-in-charge is available by phone in their absence



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of both the platform and the financial backbone of a growing business

Become the go-to person for Aroflo, with real trust and autonomy from day one

A clear, stated path to full-time hours as the role proves out

Future scope to grow into lead generation and CRM work as the business expands



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

title: Vehicle Research Assistant
description:
Job Title: Vehicle Acquisition Research Assistant (Automotive / Car Auctions)



Location: Remote

Job Type / Type of Employment: Part-Time 

Hours: ~24 hours/week

Pay: $4/hour





About the Position

We are a growing U.S.-based vehicle rental company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and resourceful Vehicle Acquisition Research Virtual Assistant to help us find potential vehicles to purchase and add to our fleet.



We regularly purchase vehicles through dealer-only auto auctions and other sources, including
 Marketplace.

Your primary responsibility will be to research upcoming auctions, identify promising vehicles, evaluate listings against our purchasing criteria, and organize your findings into clear, actionable reports.



We aren't looking for someone who simply copies and pastes car listings. We're looking for someone who can develop an understanding of what makes a vehicle a good investment for our business and help us consistently identify worthwhile purchasing opportunities.



You don't need to be a professional mechanic or car expert. We're willing to train the right person. However, strong research skills, attention to detail, organization, and independent thinking are essential.





Key Responsibilities

 • Research vehicles across auction platforms such as Manheim, ADESA, CarMax Auctions, and others.

 • Monitor upcoming auctions and newly added vehicle listings.

 • Create and update vehicle watchlists ahead of auction and preview deadlines.

 • Evaluate listings based on mileage, condition, title status, pricing, and our purchasing criteria.

 • Identify potential red flags and promising deals.

 • Research vehicles on
 Marketplace and other approved platforms.

 • Prepare clear daily reports with vehicle details, links, findings, and recommendations.

 • Track potential purchases, inspection results, and auction deadlines.

 • Eventually assist with coordinating vehicle inspections, communicating with mechanics, and contacting sellers.



Qualifications

Required:

 • Strong online research and analytical skills.

 • Excellent attention to detail and organization.

 • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, Google Sheets, and online platforms.

 • Ability to compare information and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.

 • Strong written English communication skills.

 • Ability to follow instructions while also thinking independently.

 • Reliable internet connection and computer.

 • Ability to meet deadlines and work consistently.

 • Willingness to learn about vehicles, automotive auctions, and our acquisition criteria.



Preferred but Not Required:

 • Experience researching used vehicles or automotive listings.

 • Familiarity with Manheim, ADESA, CarMax Auctions, or other vehicle auction platforms.

 • Knowledge of vehicle makes, models, reliability, and common mechanical issues.

 • Experience researching
 Marketplace listings.

 • Experience with vehicle history reports, VIN research, or automotive pricing.

 • Previous experience in automotive sales, dealerships, fleet management, or vehicle acquisition.



Automotive experience is a plus, but we're more interested in finding someone who is thorough, dependable, resourceful, and willing to learn.



Because auctions and vehicle preview opportunities occur throughout the week, some tasks will be time-sensitive.

We value efficiency and results. While accurate time reporting is expected, we don't believe in unnecessary micromanagement. We're looking for someone who can manage their responsibilities independently, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver quality work.



What We Offer

 • Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based company.

 • Remote work with a flexible part-time schedule.

 • Training on our vehicle acquisition criteria and processes.

 • Opportunity to develop specialized automotive research and acquisition skills.

 • Increasing responsibility and independence as you demonstrate your capabilities.

 • Potential for additional hours and professional growth as our business expands.

 • Supportive, organized work environment that values initiative and problem-solving.



Who Would Be a Great Fit?

This position may be a great fit if you:

 • Enjoy researching and finding good deals.

 • Like comparing options and figuring out which ones are worth pursuing.

 • Are naturally curious and pay attention to details others might overlook.

 • Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

 • Take ownership of your responsibilities.

 • Enjoy learning new industries and developing specialized skills.

 • Prefer a position where your research and recommendations contribute directly to real business decisions.

We want someone who will eventually be able to look at a list of vehicles and confidently explain which ones deserve our attention, which ones should be avoided, and why.





How to Apply



Please submit:

 1. Your resume 

 2. A unique 1–2 minute video created specifically for this role 

In your video:

 • Introduce yourself 

 • Explain your relevant experience 

 • Tell us why you’d be a good fit for this position 

You may record your video using:

 • Loom 

 • Your phone 

 • Your laptop 

Upload the video to:

 • Loom 

 • Google Drive 

 • Dropbox 

Then send:

 • Your resume link 

 • Your video link 

through your OnlineJobs.ph application message.

Applications missing either link may not be considered. Please ensure all links are publicly viewable.

title: GoHighLevel Expert Needed to Build Snapshot, Funnels & Lead Automations
description:
GoHighLevel Expert Needed to Build Snapshot, Funnels & Lead Automations

Location: Remote

Project type: Initial setup project 20 to 30 hrs, with potential for ongoing work

Experience level: Experienced

Compensation: Please provide your proposed project rate or hourly rate

About the Project.







I’m looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to help set up a lead generation and follow-up system for company, a local marketing business.



Our Business Helps local businesses, especially showrooms and home improvement companies, get found by more potential customers through Google Maps and local search.



The goal is to create a system that captures leads, follows up with them, and helps turn them into booked appointments. I’m also looking for a reusable GoHighLevel snapshot that can be updated and used as the business grows.





What You’ll Help Set Up

1. Lead Generation Funnels

Build or improve funnels that encourage prospects to request a free local visibility report or book a call.



This may include:

- Landing pages for lead capture and appointment booking.

- Forms and surveys to collect prospect information.

- Calendar integration and booking confirmations.

- Thank-you pages with clear next steps.

- Mobile-friendly layouts.

- Basic tracking for form submissions and booked appointments.





I can provide information about the offer, target audience, branding, and any existing pages. I’d like your recommendations on what can be reused and what should be built or improved.



2. Lead Follow-Up Automations

Create practical workflows that help us respond to and follow up with leads, including:

- Follow-up when someone submits a form or requests a report.

-
 and SMS follow-up, where appropriate.

- Appointment confirmations and reminders.

- Follow-up for missed appointments and cancellations.

- Follow-up for leads who have not booked a call.

- Notifications and tasks for our team.

- Tags and pipeline updates based on lead activity.

- Stopping or adjusting follow-up when someone books, replies, or asks not to be contacted.

I’d like someone who can recommend the right workflow and messaging based on our sales process, not just build a large number of automations.





3. CRM and Sales Pipeline

Organize GoHighLevel so we can easily track leads from the first interaction through the sales process.



This may include:

- Setting up or improving the sales pipeline and opportunity stages.

- Creating custom fields, tags, and lead sources.

- Organizing leads from forms, calls, and other outreach.

- Creating tasks and notifications for follow-up.

- Providing a clear way to see where each prospect stands.



4. Reusable GoHighLevel Snapshot





Create a snapshot containing the agreed-upon components, such as workflows, funnels, forms, pipeline stages, and custom fields.



Please identify anything that must be configured separately when the snapshot is installed in another account, such as integrations, connected calendars, phone numbers, or sending settings. I’d also like you to test the snapshot in a separate account or test environment, if available.

What I’m Looking For

- Proven experience building GoHighLevel funnels, workflows, and snapshots.

- Experience setting up lead generation and appointment-booking systems.

- Ability to organize a CRM and sales pipeline.

- Experience with
 and SMS follow-up workflows.

- Good understanding of forms, calendars, tags, custom fields, and triggers.

- Ability to explain your recommendations clearly.

- Strong attention to detail and willingness to test your work.

- Clear communication and reliable delivery.





Experience working with marketing agencies, local businesses, Google Business Profile services, or local SEO is a plus.

Deliverables

At the end of the project, I’d like:

- The agreed-upon funnels, pipeline, and automations built and tested.

- A reusable snapshot with the agreed components.

- A list of what is included and what requires separate setup.

- A short walkthrough video or live walkthrough explaining how everything works.

- Basic documentation so my team can manage and update the system.

How to Apply

Please keep your application focused and answer the following:

1. Experience: How long have you worked with GoHighLevel, and what types of systems have you built?

2. Examples: Share one or two examples of funnels, automations, or snapshots you’ve created. Please explain what you personally built.

3. Approach: How would you set up follow-up for someone who requests a free visibility report but does not book a call?

4. Snapshot: What are some things that may need to be configured separately after installing a snapshot?

5. Availability: When can you start, and how many hours per week are you available?

6. Pricing: What is your hourly rate? If you prefer project-based pricing, explain what information you need to provide a quote.

Please begin your application with “GHL Lead System” so I know you’ve read the description.



Selected applicants may be invited to a short video call to discuss the project and their experience.



Thank you,

Hank

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/telehealth-technical-support-357d36ee/apply?ref=kvmg4yxd . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions, including one troubleshooting scenario. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type TABLET.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real support call, then talk a patient through joining his visit (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

You will lead our three existing platform specialists, set strategy and goals for each channel, and personally build and manage our Faire wholesale channel. This is a growth role, not a maintenance role. You will be measured on sales growth, profitability, and advertising efficiency.



Responsibilities

Manage, coach, and hold accountable our Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify specialists.

Build and grow our Faire wholesale channel, including retailer outreach, wholesale pricing, and promotions.

Lead SEO and listing optimization across all platforms, including titles, keywords, images, A plus content, and brand stores.

Manage advertising budgets and campaigns on Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify, with a focus on return on ad spend.

Full time, long term. Performance bonus available based on sales growth.

title: CEO
description:
About the Role



This is not a virtual assistant position. You will run our online channels the way a general manager runs a business. You will report directly to our CEO, lead a small team of platform specialists, and be responsible for one clear goal: building our online business to USD 3 million in annual sales within 18 months. If you have ever wanted to be treated as the owner of a business instead of a task worker, and you have the experience to hit a target like this, this role is built for you.



Our 18 Month Goal



- Month 6: online sales of USD 100,000 per month

- Month 12: online sales of USD 175,000 per month

- Month 18: online sales of USD 250,000 per month, a USD 3 million annual run rate

- All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits



Compensation



- Base salary of PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience

- Quarterly performance bonus based on growth in online gross profit

- Milestone bonuses paid when each of the month 6, 12, and 18 targets is reached

- Eligibility for a long term profit sharing arrangement after 12 months for the right person

- Paid time off and holidays

- A direct relationship with the CEO and real authority to make decisions



We currently sell one brand online and are preparing to launch our second brand along with several new products. Your mission is to lead that expansion and build our online business into a major sales channel for the company. Within your first six months, we expect our second brand and new products to be live across our online channels. By month 12, we are targeting online sales of USD 70,000 to 110,000 per month. By month 18, our committed goal is USD 125,000 per month, with a stretch goal of USD 250,000 per month, which represents a USD 3 million annual run rate. All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits, and bonuses are significantly larger for reaching the stretch goal.



Your base salary will be PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience, plus a 13th month payment each December. When our second brand and new products are successfully launched within your first six months, you will receive a USD 1,500 launch bonus. Starting in month 7, you will earn a quarterly bonus equal to 5 percent of the growth in our online contribution profit, which is net sales after product costs, platform fees, fulfillment, advertising, and returns. You will also earn milestone bonuses of USD 2,000 for reaching the month 12 committed goal or USD 4,000 for reaching the stretch goal, and USD 4,000 for reaching the month 18 committed goal or USD 10,000 for reaching the stretch goal. After 12 months, the right person will also become eligible for a long term profit sharing arrangement in the online business. If we reach USD 3 million together, your total earnings will place you among the best compensated ecommerce leaders in the Philippines.

How to Apply



Please send:

- Your resume

- A short summary of 2 to 3 online stores or brands you managed, including what you grew sales from and to

- A 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach growing a food and beverage brand to USD 3 million in online sales in 18 months

title: Healthcare Technical Support
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

An 81-year-old patient calls ten minutes before his video visit. His tablet screen is dark and he is not sure it is charged. You stay calm, find out what he sees, get the tablet charging and on Wi-Fi, and get him into the visit before his nurse gives up waiting.



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/telehealth-technical-support-357d36ee/apply?ref=xrfqfkc6 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions, including one troubleshooting scenario. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type TABLET.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real support call, then talk a patient through joining his visit (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Lead Researcher / List Builder – Amazon Seller Leads (Verified Emails, No Duplicates)
description:
We are a Dubai-based e-commerce consultancy working with Amazon brands and sellers in Germany, the UK and the US. We need someone who builds clean, verified lead lists of Amazon sellers for our outbound campaigns.



This is detail work. We do not need volume. We need lists we can load into our sending tool without cleaning them first.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research Amazon third-party sellers and brands and deliver them in a Google Sheet with these exact columns:



First Name

Last Name

Job Title


LinkedIn URL

Company Name

Amazon Seller Page (storefront or brand page URL)

Company Country

Seller Type (Private Label / Brand Owner / Reseller / Aggregator / Agency)

Company Website

Employees

Company LinkedIn URL

Monthly Revenue (estimate)

Review Rating



QUALITY RULES (this is what the job is really about)



1. Right person, not just any person. We need the decision maker: Founder, Owner, CEO, Managing Director, Head of E-Commerce, Amazon Manager, Marketplace Manager. Not interns, not warehouse staff, not accountants. If a company has no reachable decision maker, skip it.



2. Verified emails only. Every personal email must be run through a verification tool (NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, ZeroBounce or similar) and marked as valid. "Accept-all" or "risky" results are not acceptable and must be excluded, not included with a note. Our bounce rate must stay under 2 percent.



3. Zero duplicates. No duplicate emails, no duplicate companies, no duplicate domains across the whole list AND against the master list we give you. You dedupe before you deliver, not us.



4. Amazon Seller Page is mandatory. If you cannot find the actual Amazon storefront or brand page of the company, the lead does not go on the list. This is our most important filter. A company that "probably sells on Amazon" is not a lead.



5. Revenue estimate must come from a source. Use Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerAmp, Keepa, Similarweb or public company data. Write the source in a notes column. Never guess.



6. Data must be clean. Correct spelling and capitalisation of first names (we use them in email personalisation, so "MARIA" or "maria" or "M. Schmidt" is a fail), no trailing spaces, consistent country names, working URLs.



TOOLS

You should be comfortable with at least some of: 
, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, 
, Clay, Helium 10 / Jungle Scout / Keepa, Google Sheets. Tell us which ones you have access to and which ones we would need to provide.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You are a good fit if you are patient, precise, and you would rather deliver 100 perfect leads than 500 messy ones. You check your own work before you send it. You ask questions when a rule is unclear instead of guessing.



You are not a good fit if you plan to scrape a database, export it and send it over unverified. We check every list we receive.



HOURS AND START

Start part time, around 20 hours per week, with a fixed weekly delivery target we agree together. If the quality is right, this becomes a long-term full-time role with a raise. We pay on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. Answer these in your message:



1. Put the word AMAZON-LIST in the first line of your application, so we know you read this.

2. Which tools do you currently have paid access to?

3. How do you verify an email before putting it on a list? Name the tool and the exact steps.

4. How would you find the Amazon storefront of a brand when the brand does not link to it from their website?

5. Send one sample: 5 real Amazon seller leads with all columns above filled in. Use any niche you like. This tells us more than your CV.



Applications without the sample will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Operations VA for Short Term Rental
description:
Overview

We operate a 30+ unit Airbnb/STR portfolio across multiple US markets. Our AI messaging system already handles routine guest messages. We are NOT hiring someone to answer messages. We are hiring someone to solve the problems the AI can't — the locked-out guest at 9PM, the cleaner who didn't show, the vendor who quoted double, the damage claim that needs evidence assembled.

This role comes with real decision-making authority. You will have written authority limits (e.g, approve vendor spend up to a set amount, guest issues) and you are expected to USE them without asking permission. In this company, you will never be penalized for making a reasonable decision within your authority. You WILL be coached if you escalate things you had the authority to d
 yourself.

Top performers are compensated above market and given increasing ownership as we scale — our next team lead will be promoted from this role, not hired externally.

Must-Haves (do not apply without these)

* You already live a night-shift lifestyle. Shifts are 9 hours within 7AM–8PM PST (roughly 10PM–11AM Philippine time). Do not apply if you plan to "adjust" — we only hire people who have ALREADY worked graveyard/US hours for 6+ months and can tell us how they sustain it. This is a hard filter; our last several departures were all sleep-schedule failures.

* 1+ year hands-on STR/Airbnb operations experience (guest issues, cleaner coordination, OTA platforms). PMS/channel manager familiarity.

* Airbnb claims/AirCover experience strongly preferred.

* Strong spoken English — this role makes multiple phone calls daily to US-based guests, cleaners, and vendors. You must be comfortable picking up the phone without being told to.

* Comfortable being the most senior person online during your shift. There is no manager to hand problems off to.

Key Responsibilities

* Own all guest issues the AI escalates: access problems, WiFi, appliances, complaints, special requests — resolve end-to-end

* Coordinate cleaners: scheduling, confirmations, photo QC, same-day turnover problems

* Manage vendors and maintenance: source quotes, schedule, follow up, verify completion

* Handle Airbnb claims and damage documentation

* Maintain calendar accuracy across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct bookings

* Convert every escalation into a documented rule/SOP so the same problem never needs an owner decision twice

* Weekend coverage required (especially Sunday/Monday mornings PST)

Work Setup

Remote, full-time, 2 days off per week. 9-hour shift within the 7AM–8PM PST window (exact shift set at hiring). [
a month paid bi-weekly depending on experience], performance raises reviewed at 90 days.

HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, incomplete applications are auto-rejected

Start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE so we know you read this posting.

Our hiring process has three stages: this written application, an unscheduled live video call where we work through operational scenarios together in real time, and a paid trial shift. Your written answers will be verified in detail on the live call — only apply with real experience, because invented details do not survive stage two. We screen for AI-generated responses and disqualify them.

1. Your actual experience — state facts, we will verify them

* Maximum number of units you handled AT THE SAME TIME (not cumulative), and for how long

* Which markets/states, and which PMS/channel manager you used daily

* How many cleaners and vendors you personally coordinated

* On a typical day, how many guest escalations did you handle, and what were the two most common types?

2. Night-shift proof: How long have you worked PH graveyard hours continuously, for which employer, and what is your actual daily sleep routine?

3. Judgment scenario: A guest at check-in messages that the smart lock is dead. The cleaner isn't answering. It's 9PM local time and the owner is unreachable for the next 3 hours. Walk us through everything you do, in exact order, including what you d
 WITHOUT permission and what your fallback is if your first fix fails. (Finalists will solve a live variation of this on camera.)

4. Systems example: Describe, in this numbered format:

1. A specific operational problem you personally faced

2. The exact system or process you built to prevent it recurring

3. The measurable result — include real numbers

Applications that skip the keyword, answer the scenario with "I would contact the owner," or give generic answers with no specific details will not receive a response.
